Moving intosummer, the remainder of the season was moderate, giving us thelong, cool season Corison was hoping for.

name: Corison Cabernet Sauvignon (375ML half-bottle) 2016
notes: The 2016 reminds Cathy of the 2014 with the volume turned up a bit. Redolentwith bright red currant, blueberry, tart cherry and darker plums, cassis andblackberry fruit, it is wildly complex. The fruit aromatics are complexed by baking spices and floral notes including dried rose petals and violets. Varietal dried herbs add yet another dimension. An alluring yin of minerality and snappy natural acidity play off against the yang of a broad, luscious mouth feel.

name: Corison Cabernet Sauvignon (375ML half-bottle) 2017
notes: The 2017 Cabernet Sauvignon speaks eloquently of its growing season with dense, rich, layered dark fruit flavors including black raspberries, dried cherries, dark plums, cassis and boysenberries, set off by the snappy natural acidity that is a hallmark of Corison Cabernets. It is wildly complex, with baking spice and anise notes joining dried Herbs de Provence and hints of peppermint. Floral perfume is already in evidence with rose petals, violets and lavender chiming in. It feels like silk velvet on the  palate.

name: Corison Cabernet Sauvignon (torn label) 2005
notes: The 2005 Corison Cabernet is classic and refined with great bones. Inviting aromas jump out of the glass. Cherry pie, complete with allspice, nutmeg and cardamom, dominates the aromas and flavors with hints of plum, cassis, lavender and dark chocolate chiming in. The overall impression is warm and engaging.

name: Corison Kronos Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon 2001
notes: 2001 was a classic vintage, with ideal conditions for making powerful yet elegant wines.  There was not a single heat spike over 100 °F during the entire ripening season.  Warm days and cool, foggy nights resulted in inky color and full, complex flavors.  The spare rainfall during the winter months favored a smaller than average crop, contributing uncommon intensity to the wine.

name: Corison Kronos Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon 2004
notes: “The season started with a very early spring and finished with a slow and steady ripening period with nary a day over 100F. We picked very early, enjoying perfect weather. Extremely low yields resulted in exceptional concentration.

name: Corison Kronos Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon 2013
notes: Wow. This inky wine jumps out of the glass with ripe boysenberries and floral perfume. 2013 was a near-perfect vintage with ideal spring weather for flowering, which resulted in a bumper crop of deliciousness. With highs seldom climbing out of the 80F’s and chilly nighttime lows, an unseasonably cool summer gave the wine its firm structure. Lush ripe red fruit with balancing natural acidity complement the characteristic Kronos viscosity. The tannins are assertive but feel like velvet.

name: Corison Kronos Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon 2016
notes: The 2016 boasts immensely complex fruit flavors with more of the bright red and blue end of the Cabernet spectrum than in some vintages. Black cherry, blueberry, elderberry and plum join the characteristic blackberry and boysenberry notes for a kaleidoscope of aromas. Floral perfume of violets and lilac chime in, with baking spices, dried herbs, cocoa nibs and wet-stone minerality adding yet more layers of harmony. Like the voices in an accomplished choir, the blend is seamless. As always, the tannins are abundant and feel like velvet and the finish goes on and on. This wine displays remarkable unity.

name: Corliss Cabernet Sauvignon (1.5 Liter Magnum) 2009
notes: Brooding dark fruit aromas of wild fig, blackberry and cassis,with warm, underlying notes of cocoa, roasted coffee bean and crème brûlée. The wine saturates the palate upon entry with outstanding depth and intensity of dark fruit flavors. A complex array of black fruits, licorice and spice slowly develop into more earth-driven flavors of sage, wet earth and tobacco. Powerful and seamless in texture, with densely packed, fine-grain tannins,  a graphite-like minerality, and a savory, long-lasting finish.

name: Corliss Cabernet Sauvignon 2005
notes: 75% Cabernet Sauvignon, 13% Merlot, 6% Cabernet Franc, 4% Malbec and 2% Petit Verdot

name: Corliss Cabernet Sauvignon 2006
notes: The 2006 Cabernet shows dark plum and blackberry fruits on the nose with underlying aromas of dried leaf, mocha, menthol and graphite. Rich and dense in the mouth with flavors of blackberry, licorice and Christmas spices being supported by a firm minerality. Fine, ripe tannins lead way to a long, drawn out and lingering finish.

name: Corliss Cabernet Sauvignon 2009
notes: Brooding dark fruit aromas of wild fig, blackberry and cassis,with warm,underlying notes of cocoa, roasted coffee bean and crème brûlée. The wine saturates the palate upon entry with outstanding depth and intensity of dark fruit flavors. A complex array of black fruits, licorice and spice slowly develop into more earth-driven flavors of sage, wet earth and tobacco. Powerful and seamless in texture, with densely packed, fine-grain tannins,  a graphite-like minerality, and a savory, long-lasting finish.

name: Corliss Cabernet Sauvignon 2010
notes: Brooding dark fruit aromas of wild fig, blackberry and cassis, with warm, underlying notes of cocoa, roasted coffee bean and crème brûlée. The wine saturates the palate upon entry with outstanding depth and intensity of dark fruit flavors. A complex array of black fruits, licorice and spice slowly develop into more earth-driven flavors of sage, wet earth and tobacco. Powerful and seamless in texture, with densely packed, fine-grain tannins,  a graphite-like minerality, and a savory, long-lasting finish.

name: Corliss Cabernet Sauvignon 2011
notes: Seductive, dark fruit aromas of dried fig, black cherry and cassis are infused with notes of sage, menthol and smoldering incense. The wine is immediately full on entry, with flavors of sweet, sappy black fruits, espresso and crème brulee that gradually give way to more complex, earth-driven characters of sun-dried black olive, licorice root and gravel. Firm, densely-packed tannins saturate the mouth, effortlessly drawing the palate out to a rich, long-lasting finish.

name: Corliss Red (1.5 Liter Magnum) 2009
notes: Complex and intriguing on the nose,with aromas of redcurrant, strawberry and dried red fruits, infused with earthy notes of cedar, black tea and tobacco. The palate is dense and plush with an excellent concentration of red and black fruit flavors.The sheer abundance of fruit is supported by fine-grained, dusty tannins that slowly fill the mouth, drawing out the palate to an incredibly long-lasting, silky finish.

name: Corliss Red 2006
notes: The 2006 displays a complex nose bright cherry and redcurrant fruits, with deeper layers of sage, bay leaf and fragrant spice. An instant explosion of thick, fleshy tannins provide excellent weight and density to the mid-palate and carry on to a lush and lingering finish.

name: Corliss Red 2005
notes: 66% Cabernet Sauvignon, 10% Merlot, 9% Malbec, 8% Cabernet Franc 8%, 7% Petit Verdot

name: Corliss Red 2009
notes: Complex and intriguing on the nose,with aromas of redcurrant, strawberry and dried red fruits, infused with earthy notes of cedar, black tea and tobacco. The palate is dense and plush with an excellent concentration of red and black fruit flavors.The sheer abundance of fruit is supported by fine-grained, dusty tannins that slowly fill the mouth, drawing out the palate to an incredibly long-lasting, silky finish.

name: Corliss Red 2010
notes: Complex and intriguing on the nose,with aromas of redcurrant, strawberry and dried red fruits, infused with earthy notes of cedar, black tea and tobacco. The palate is dense and plush with an excellent concentration of red and black fruit flavors.The sheer abundance of fruit is supported by fine-grained, dusty tannins that slowly fill the mouth, drawing out the palate to an incredibly long-lasting, silky finish.

name: Corliss Red 2011
notes: A deeply layered nose offering strikingly delineated aromas of blackberry, dried redcurrant and cassis, with lifted herbaceous notes of mint, bay leaf and thyme. The wine is powerfully textured on entry, showing an array of wild, dark berry fruits, and deep underlying flavors of sage, cured meats and blackened earth. Sweet, sappy tannins meld with a firm, graphite-like minerality to provide excellent length and a wonderfully youthful energy that promises long-term aging potential.

name: Corliss Syrah 2007
notes: The 2007 Corliss Syrah shows of aromas of black fig, plum, tar and cassis on the nose with underlying exotic spices, dried cherry, violet and jasmine. A soft entry to the palate immediately leads to density and opulence with juicy black fruit flavors, dried cherry and rhubarb, plum and cocoa. Fine, mouth-filling tannins continually build, drawing out the palate to a long, lingering finish.

name: Cornell Vineyards Cabernet Sauvignon 2016
notes: The 2016 Cabernet Sauvignon begins with a deep garnet color that leads to aromas of dark and red fruits and underlying forest floor. On the palate, blackberry and tart blueberry integrate with dark chocolate, dried sage, and fresh herbs. Balance is achieved between the energy and fine tannins and the deep, powerful, age-worthy nature of this wine.

name: Cornerstone Cellars Black Label Cabernet Franc 2012
notes: Showing true expression of its varietal, this is a 100% pure, rich, classic Cabernet Franc showcasing savory aromas of dried herbs, black tea leaves, fresh tobacco all intertwined with sweet, red berry fruits and nuances of barrel spice. With a lively inner-mouthenergy through a beautifully balanced acidity this Cabernet Franc is both vibrant and sexy with a smooth, refined texture, suave tannins and a clean, velvety, persistent finish. Drinking beautifully now this Cabernet Franc will become even more delicious withsome age for the patient among us.

name: Cornerstone Cellars Howell Mountain Cabernet Sauvignon 2008
notes: The 2009 Howell Mountain Cabernet Sauvignon is abundant in fragrant, ever-­changing aromatics of concentrated dark fruit notes laced with cinnamon, forest floor and sweet cocoa. The palate is awakened with a full-­bodied richness and texture giving a layered mouthfeel balanced with a lifted acidity. Lingering, complex tannins broaden out the finish to display the formidable structure and power of this Cabernet Sauvignon. Although quite approachable now, bottle ageing will further develop the bouquet and complexity. This wine possess immense concentration and power while retaining sublime elegance and will continue to age superbly over the next two decades.

name: Cornerstone Cellars Howell Mountain Cabernet Sauvignon 2013
notes: The first swirl offers dense, ripe fruit with layers of fresh herbs, cigar box and anise, just as we have grown to expect from mountain fruit. On the palate you will find a rhythm of subtle toast, succeeded by roasted dark coffee beans laced with hints of cocoa and vanilla. The texture is plush, elegant; with integrated tannins offering both substance and restraint. As always, a sturdy and sumptuous Howell Mountain Cabernet will develop and intensify artfully over time.

name: Cornerstone Cellars Michael's Cuvee Cabernet Sauvignon 2012
notes: The 2012 Cornerstone Cellars Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon, Michael's Cuvee is a classic, powerful, but elegantly structured Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon. Deeply colored with rich, cassis laden aromatics, it is youthful and concentrated at this point and will develop even more complexity and elegance as it ages over the next decade or more. While voluptuous and richly textured it is still bright and fresh with a long, smooth finish.

name: Cornerstone Cellars Willamette Valley Pinot Noir 2012
notes: The warmer 2012 vintage delivered deep, round velvety Pinot Noir with a forward, expressive character that is already delicious to drink. Very complex and layered with racy acidity that lifts the palate and leads into a long, finish that dances across the entire palate. Certainly five to seven years of cellar age will be well rewarded.

name: Cornerstone Cellars Willamette Valley Pinot Noir 2013
notes: A round velvety Pinot Noir with a forward, expressive character that is already delicious to drink. Very complex and layered with racy acidity that lifts the palate and leads into a long, finish that dances across the entire palate. Certainly five to seven years of cellar age will be well rewarded.

name: Corofin Churton Vineyard Clod Block 2017
notes: The 2017 vintage is sappy and structured, with layers that build seamlessly into a velvety richness, captivating and thought-provoking. Lighter and finer to taste, again different but in such a good way.

name: Corofin Settlement Vineyard East Slope Pinot Noir 2017
notes: The 2017 vintage radiates its typical warmth and freshness with red and blue fruits layered over earthy aromatics. Sleek yet firm tannins frame the silken palate.

name: Corra Winery Cabernet Sauvignon (1.5 Liter Magnum) 2016
notes: Great vineyards in great vintages are nothing but pure joy in liquid form. The 2016 Corra Cabernet Sauvignon shows dark purple color, warm blueberry/huckleberry aromas and a dense, full, rich entry. True to the sophisticated style of Corra, the wine has the structure of a wine built to age well for decades, yet the finish shows a texture of heavy satin.

name: Corra Winery Cabernet Sauvignon 2006
notes: The 2006 vintage of Corra Cabernet offers aromas of gorgeous currant, black cherry, blackberry, chocolate and sweet toasty oak that burst out of the glass.  This wine shows amazing purity of fruit, focus, balance and depth on the palate, with tiers of deeply concentrated fruit, anise, and licorice. Lush and full-bodied, this wine combines power, grace and finesse, offering a dense core of mocha-laced blackberry, wild berry and spice layered on top of silky, supple tannins.  The seductive finish lingers, repeating the core flavor themes.  This wine will leave you satisfied, yet wanting more.

name: Corra Winery Cabernet Sauvignon 2007
notes: The 2007 Corra Cabernet Sauvignon displays provocative aromas of spiced raspberry and ripe blackberry, sweet tea, vanilla, cinnamon and sage notes, intermixed with a touch of cocoa/mocha adding depth to the gloriously sweet fruit. On the palate, this multi-dimensional wine offers a full, luscious entry with impressive concentration, displaying all the ripe blackberry and cherry intensity that is characteristic of the 2007 vintage. The mid-palate is full, rich, and opulent, supported by a harmonious tannin profile that is structural as well as silky. The juicy fruit flavors are pure and vibrant, with dark cherry notes that linger on the seductive finish.

name: Corra Winery Cabernet Sauvignon (stained labels( 2005
notes: Aromas of cassis, dark cherry, chocolate, espresso and orange peel lift from the glass. Underneath these attributes are hints of forest floor, hazelnut, and vanilla. The entry is smooth, rich and creamy with flavors of black pepper, sweet raspberry, cassis, and baking spices. The wine is well-balanced with good intensity and concentration veiled by a silky texture. Flavors of dark chocolate and orange peel linger.

name: Corrina Rayment Expatriate Shiraz 2005
notes: "The 2005 Shiraz "Expatriate" was tasted from a barrel sample. It is dense crimson/purple in color with a brooding nose of mineral, leather, spice box, blueberry, and blackberry liqueur. This is followed by a full-bodied, voluptuous wine with layered, thick, intense flavors, well-concealed tannins, and a very long finish. Give it 5-7 years to blossom and drink it through 2025." - Robert Parker

name: Corrina Rayment Revolution Shiraz 2006
notes: These relatively young vines are already producing voluptuous and flavor packed rich fruit. Perfect for this wine.

name: Corte Pavone Brunello di Montalcino 2006
notes: The finest sites and soils are planted with carefully selected clones of Sangiovese for the production of Brunello. Aromatic plants and herbs such as rosemary, lavender and thyme grow among the vines in the Corte Pavone estate and these and many more characterize the aromas and flavors of the complex and deep Brunello di Montalcino which comes from these vineyards.

name: Corte Riva Cabernet Sauvignon 2003
notes: The Cabernet Sauvignon exhibits aromas of forest floor, blackberries, and cassis as well as beautiful tannin management in the sense that the tannins are silky. This approachable, soft, generous, evolved, seductive wine can be consumed over the next decade.

name: Corte Sant'Alda Pithos Bianco 2010
notes: Pithos Bianco, made from 100% Grecanico is well-structured, savory white that has a golden-orange color, flavors of dried apricots, almonds and a medium body.

name: Corte Sant'Alda Soave Vigne Di Mezzane 2009
notes: The Soave's extended exposure to the skins give the wine an intense yellow color and scents of ripe apples. On the palate it gives off flavors of ripe citrus fruit and golden apples along with a classic almond finish.

name: Corte Sant'Alda Valpolicella Ca Fiui 2009
notes: Mid-intensity bright red color.  Fresh, with cherry, raspberry and mineral notes.  Pleasant and smooth on the palate, with flavors of ripe cherry and plum.

name: Corte Sant'Alda Valpolicella Superiore Ripasso Campi Magri 2007
notes: 30% Corvina, 30% Rondinella, 25% Corvina Grossa, 10% Molinara.

name: Cortijo Tinto 2011
notes: This wine is a pure, bright expression of Estate fruit from Rioja Alta. 100% Unoaked. An impressive wine that sells for a song! The 20% Garnacha brings forth bright fruit flavors and complex red berry aromas.

name: Cos Cerasuolo di Vittoria Pithos 2010
notes: The Cerasuolo di Vittoria Pithos is a deep ruby red with garnet highlights. On the nose are aromas of cherry, prunes and dried flowers. In the mouth it is full-bodied and well structured with flavors corresponding to the nose. It has a long and fresh finish.

name: Cos Nero Di Lupo 2009
notes: Ruby red in color with garnet reflections. On the nose, the wine has beautiful aromas of cherry, mature plum and licorice. The taste has good balance with the nose showing those same flavors of cherry and plum. The tannins are very soft and the wine has well-balanced acidity with a persistent finish.

name: Cos Cerasuolo di Vittoria Pithos 2012
notes: The Cerasuolo di Vittoria Pithos is a deep ruby red with garnet highlights. On the nose are aromas of cherry, prunes and dried flowers. In the mouth it is full-bodied and well structured with flavors corresponding to the nose. It has along and fresh finish.

name: Corrina Rayment Expatriate Shiraz 2006
notes: More than half of the fruit for this wine was selected from Don Oliver's oldest block of 65-year old vines. For complexity, some plantings from the Tahbilk clone were blended in. The Tahbilk clone is one of the oldest know Shiraz clones in Australia. It expresses Rhone-like aromatics with lifted violet and mineral tones. The Olivers sourced this clone from Victoria and were one of the first to plant it in McLaren Vale.

name: Cosentino Cigar Old Vine Zinfandel 2015
notes: The wine is deep and alluring with aromas of pepper spice, coffee and nutmeg. The palate is rich with voluptuous flavors of baking spice, coffee and cocoa with a balanced and lingering finish.

name: Cosentino Cigar Old Vine Zinfandel 2017
notes: The wine is deep and alluring with aromas of spice, peppercorn and chocolate. The palate is rich with voluptuous flavors of succulent ripe berry, coffee, cocoa and a trace of leather with well-rounded mouthfeel and full finish.

name: Cosentino Hoopes Ranch Cabernet Sauvignon 2002
notes: Complex notes of spice, minerals, earth and black fruits commingle in an almost exotic melange of aromas and flavors.This is a wine of great purity. Distinctive Graves - like lead pencil in the nose with notes of oak and blue berries. Richly concentrated with excellent balance on the palate. Cabernet Sauvignon that exhibits the special uniqueness of the Oakville appellation.

name: Cosentino M. Coz Meritage 1997
notes: Currant, baked rhubarb and creamy raspberry in the nose. Bold cranberry fruit begins on the palate, moving on to a black and white pepper mouth-feel and a harmonious and lingering finish. Youthful with excellent structure, this wine should develop over the next 5-10 years and age gracefully for many more.

name: Cosentino M. Coz Meritage 1999
notes: Currant, baked rhubarb and creamy raspberry in the nose. Bold cranberry fruit begins on the palate, moving on to a black and white pepper mouth-feel and a harmonious and lingering finish. Youthful with excellent structure, this wine should develop over the next 5-10 years and age gracefully for many more.

name: Cosentino Napa Cabernet Franc 1999
notes: Blackberry and currants in the nose with hints of clove and black cherry. Youthful and intense ripe fruit with plum characteristics follow pepper into the mouth. Well balanced with good structure.

name: Cosentino Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon 1999
notes: Black olive and black rose in the nose. Plum spice gets attention in the mouth, along with more blackberry, pepper and hints of mineral.

name: Cosentino The Cab 2012
notes: "The" Cab was hand picked and sorted fruit from the best vineyards in Lodi. The Cab started fermentation in stainless steel tanks and used an aerative pump over system to extend the maceration cycle for better richness and mouthfeel.

name: Cosentino The Dark 2013
notes: The 2013 The Dark is the color of ink with aromas of juniper and spice. The lush, velvety texture is full of blackberry, cassis and plum flavors with a long finish that holds just a touch of chocolate.

name: Cosentino The Dark 2015
notes: This wine is super inky in the glass with deep aromas of blueberries, blackberries, and plum. Richly textured on the palate, jammy notes are layered with black pepper spice and hints of herbs de Provence. The brooding finish is long, smooth and opulent.

name: Cosentino The Franc 2015
notes: Deep crimson in color with sweet and spicy notes of fresh herbs and cloves on the nose. On the palate, intense flavors of fruit with hints of black pepper on the palate. Ends with great structure and long finish.

name: Cossart Gordon 15 Year Baul Maderia (500 ML bottle)
notes: The 15 years Bual is a warm inviting wine with well rounded fruit flavours, wonderfully raisiny and spicy on the palate. The underlying acidity, typical of fine Madeiras, ensures an assertive albeit delicate long finish. Ideal served with cheese after a meal.

name: Costa di Bussia Barolo Bussia Riserva 2013
notes: The mention Riserva means selection, longer aging and great quality. We select the grapes from the Bricco vineyard. The complexity of the bouquet inebriates the nose with hints of spices, dry flowers and underbrush. From the first sip, the excellent concentration of fine and sweet tannins fill the mouth without being aggressive. Great persistence of taste, typical of a great wine.

name: Costaripa Valtenesi Chiaretto Rosamara 2012
notes: Made with the "tear drop" method which uses the pick of the crop and applies stationary draining before fermentation, thereby obtaining what is regarded as the heart of the grape. Half of the must ferments and develops in little oak casks of a capacity of 228 litres for around 6 months.

name: Costers del Priorat Petit Pissarres 2015
notes: Intense red with purple tones. It has a very fresh aroma, full of flowers and fruits sensations that are confirmed on the palate. It is cheerful and lively and expresses citrus flavors and memories of summer stone fruits, such as peach and apricot. In the end, it appears so vibrant and enjoyable that makes us want to drink more.

name: Costers del Priorat Petit Pissarres 2016
notes: Aromas of red fruits and Mediterranean forest open to orange flowers and ripe summer peaches on the palate. This red wine is fresh and balanced showcasing its accessible character of a thirst-quenching Mediterranean red wine.

name: Cotarella Montiano 2014
notes: Montiano is deep ruby-red in color and exhibits a wide range of aromas, from vanilla to red berries along with layers of jam and sweet spice. It is powerful and full-bodied, yet well-rounded on the palate with an elegant and lingering finish.

name: Cote Bonneville Carriage House Red Blend 2008
notes: Deeply colored, its aromatics open with cherry, spice, cedar and pipe tobacco. The rich, round, lush weight of the palate carries bing cherry, boysenberry, savory fines herbs, currant, cocoa, cinnamon and toast. The growing season was not particularly warm, but heat came at just the right time to produce a marvelous vintage.

name: Cote Bonneville Carriage House Red Blend 2009
notes: From a warmer growing season, this is a big wine loaded with DuBrul cherry, blackberry, red currant, cinnamon, pepper, roasted coffee beans, chocolate, and fine tannins.  As with all Cote Bonneville reds, this ageworthy Bordeaux blend will benefit from decanting while young.

name: Cote Bonneville Carriage House Red Blend 2011
notes: Before decanting, this wine shows its savory side, pairing DuBrul cherry with cassis, fresh herbs, earth, and subtly integrated oak.  When it opens up, the dark berries, cinnamon, and cocoa shine.  Fine tannins are evident, but not overwhelming.

name: Cote Bonneville Carriage House Red Blend 2012
notes: Cote Bonneville Carriage House Red is classy expression of the alluvial terrace on which it was grown. Cherry, berry, and red currant fruits combine with coriander, cardamom, and bergamot for an exciting array of flavors. Coffee and toasty oak are supported by good structure and a long finish. With the European styling of this wine, we recommend decanting while young, and putting some in your cellar to watch it evolve with time.

name: Cote Bonneville Chardonnay 2011
notes: Another classic bright Cote Chardonnay, this one is infused with special love. The year was cool, fruit development came slowly, so our ladies picked three different times for optimal maturation. Then Kathy and Kerry hand sorted clusters to provide perfect grapes to press. Yields were down due to the cool growing season, so be sure to stock up on this one early.

name: Cote Bonneville Chardonnay 2012
notes: 2012 featured a lovely warm growing season, with plenty of cool nights and a long Indian summer. This is classical DuBrol Chardonnay, highlighting the consistency of Cote Bonneville wines. An enticing array of ripe pear, lemon creme, orange blossom, marzipan, and butterscotch are accompanied by rich creamy texture and vibrant acidity.

name: Cote Bonneville Chardonnay 2013
notes: Lemon zest, ripe Bartlett pear, and white flowers integrate with baking spices, toasty oak and the rich, creamy texture from the extended sur lees aging. This vintage has a unique baked apple component, complete with the melted brown sugar and cinnamon on the top. Yum!

name: Cote Bonneville Chardonnay 2014
notes: Always from the same rows in DuBrul Vineyard, the 2014 contains many of the same elements you know and love about this Chardonnay. Bright citrus, tropical pineapple, and delicate floral notes combine with toasted almonds and creamy brioche. This is authentic DuBrul fruit and Cote Bonneville winemaking! The beautiful grapes, extended sur lees aging, and lack of fining or filtration create a wine with intensity, rich texture, and great complexity. Laying a bottle down in your cellar for 5-10 years will pay dividends with this Chardonnay.

name: Cote Bonneville Dubrul Vineyard Red Blend 2004
notes: The power of both Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot is obvious in the deep garnet color, effusive aromatics, rich palate and texture.  It is another gorgeous Cote Bonneville expression of DuBrul Vineyard.

name: Cote Bonneville Dubrul Vineyard Red Blend 2005
notes: The power of both Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot is obvious in the deep garnet color, effusive aromatics, rich palate and texture.  It is another gorgeous Côte Bonneville expression of DuBrul Vineyard.

name: Cote Bonneville Dubrul Vineyard Red Blend 2006
notes: The power of both Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot is obvious in the deep garnet color, effusive aromatics, rich palate and texture.  It is another gorgeous Cote Bonneville expression of DuBrul Vineyard.

name: Cote Bonneville Dubrul Vineyard Red Blend 2007
notes: A flagship wine and the spectacular product of a beautiful growing season.  The power of both Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot is obvious in the deep garnet color, effusive aromatics, rich palate and texture.  It is another gorgeous Cote Bonneville expression of DuBrul Vineyard. Swirling releases cherry, raspberry, well integrated oak spice and loose leaf aromas. The mough is loaded with DuBrul cherry supported by notes of currant, tobacco, orange zest and earth on a rich mid-palate. The extended finish is textured by fine tannins.

name: Cote Bonneville Dubrul Vineyard Red Blend 2008
notes: Cote Bonneville's flagship wine is the spectacular product of a beautiful growing season.  The power of both Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot is obvious in the deep garnet color, effusive aromatics, rich palate, and texture.  It is another gorgeous Côte Bonneville expression of DuBrul Vineyard.

name: Cote Bonneville DuBrul Vineyard Riesling 2013
notes: White peach, pear, orange and lime jump out into the room as soon as the bottle is opened. Complex flavors, rich texture, vibrant acidity, and low alcohol make this Riesling perfect for any meal or occasion.

name: Cote Bonneville DuBrul Vineyard Riesling 2015
notes: Always the fruit bowl wine, the 2015 Riesling is aromatic, complex, balanced, and food friendly.  Full of tangerine, orange blossom, honeysuckle, wet stone, jasmine, and white peach.  With crisp acidity, this vintage will be especially long lived, if you have the self-restraint!

name: Cote des Roses Rose 2014
notes: A soft, pale, brilliant pink with bluish tints developing over time towards more orangey nuances. The bouquet releases aromas of summer fruits, cassis and redcurrant. Floral notes of rose along with hints of grapefruit complete the picture. The finish is fresh, offering notes of candy. On the palate the impression is fresh and full, with great aromatic persistence and balance.

name: Cote des Roses Rose 2017
notes: A soft, pale, brilliant pink with bluish tints developing over time towards more orangey nuances. The bouquet releases aromas of summer fruits, cassis, and redcurrant. Floral notes of rose along with hints of grapefruit complete the picture. The finish is fresh, offering notes of candy. On the palate, the impression is fresh and full, with great aromatic persistence and balance.

name: Cote des Roses Rose (375ML half-bottle) 2017
notes: A soft, pale, brilliant pink with bluish tints developing over time towards more orangey nuances. The bouquet releases aromas of summer fruits, cassis, and redcurrant. Floral notes of rose along with hints of grapefruit complete the picture. The finish is fresh, offering notes of candy. On the palate, the impression is fresh and full, with great aromatic persistence and balance.

name: Cotes de Ciel Ciel du Cheval Vineayrd Merlot 2012
region: Red Mountain, Yakima Valley, Columbia Valley, Washington
notes: An alluring nose of berries and dark fruits is followed with mouthfilling cherries, spices and strong notes of cocoa.  The pallet is rich with dense but supple tannins and is followed by a lingering finish.  A great choice to drink now or let age for a few years.

name: Cotes de Ciel Ciel Du Cheval Vineyard Nebbiolo 2012
region: Red Mountain, Yakima Valley, Columbia Valley, Washington
notes: Rich. A beautiful deep red wine with an intense nose of cherry, tobacco and hints of violet and rose.  The rich pallet consists of cherries, blueberries and currants. The high acidity for which Nebbiolo is known is present, but the wine has supple and elegant tannins which make this wine easy to drink. This wine will age well for at least ten years.

name: Cottanera Barbazzale Bianco 2017
notes: Straw yellow in color, with light green highlights. Mixed, delicate scent of wisteria and broom on an iodine background. A spirited freshness, leaving a pleasing, full-bodied sensation.

name: Cottanera Etna Bianco 2017
notes: 100% Carricante from vineyards that sit at 720-750 meters above sea level in Castiglione di Sicilia. Vines are 20 to 25 years old , all planted to alluvial and clay-rich lava soils. Fruit sees a 24-hour cold maceration, followed by fermentation in temperature-controlled tank. Aging sur lie takes place exclusively in stainless steel for 6 months prior to bottling.

name: Cottanera Etna Rosso 2007
notes: Etnarosso DOC is produced from Nerello Mascalese and Nerello Cappuccio grapes. An elegant, unique, prestigious wine, rich in particularly intense floral, occasionally fruity, aromas, bearing a freshness, typical of Mt. Etna. In the mouth, the wine is well structured, with dense, harsh, but not dry, tannins. The long aftertaste confirms that this is a fine wine destined to be appreciated by future generations.

name: Coturri Jessandra Santa Vittoria 1995
notes: This 70% Cabernet Sauvignon and 30% Sangiovese blend are rich in cherry-fruit with soft, velvety tannins.    Alc. 14.25%

name: Cougar Crest Estate Syrah 2002
notes: Number 33 on

name: Cougar Crest Estate Viognier 2006
region: Walla Walla Valley, Columbia Valley, Washington
notes: The '06 Viognier developed good acids, citrus, and tropical fruit aromas after another great year for balance in the vineyards. A nose of honeysuckle, white peach, and melon, prepares the palate for a juicy melange of pear, pineapple, citrus, and honeydew. No oaking or malolactic fermentation allows for a crisp finish, with a honey-like mouthfeel.

name: Couly-Dutheil Chinon La Baronnie Madeleine 2004
notes: Lovely strong ruby color with purplish reflection. Superb bouquet with red fruit aromas and spicy notes. Generous and elegant with rich high quality tannins. Very well balanced.

name: Couly-Dutheil Chinon La Baronnie Madeleine 2005
notes: Elegant and harmonious.  A grand classic.

name: Couly-Dutheil Clos l'Echo Chinon 2005
notes: Very solid, with ample flesh around the black cherry, currant, dark olive and mineral notes, followed by good grip on the smoky, briary finish. Drink now through 2011. 100 cases imported.

name: Coup de Foudre Cabernet Sauvignon 2004
notes: This first vintage of Coup de Foudre will pleasure your palate in a multi-dimensional manner.

name: Coup de Foudre Cabernet Sauvignon 2005
notes: "Coup de Foudre" or "when lightning strikes" is best enjoyed when you want to capture a special moment in time and remember it forever. Produced from the winery's four acre Stags Leap vineyard, this finest Cabernet Sauvignon has been blended with a small amount of Syrah.

name: Courbis Cornas Champelrose 2009
notes: The Cornas Champelrose comes from various vineyard parcels across the Courbis domaine.  It has generous fruit and shows the full character of its appellation in the attractive Courbis house style.

name: Courbis Cornas Champelrose 2011
notes: This wine has accessible, pure fruit and shows the full character of its appellations in the attractive Courbis house style.

name: Courbis Cornas Champelrose 2015

name: Courbis Cornas La Sabarotte 2009
notes: The Cornas La Sabarotte parcel – widely considered to be among the very best sites of the appellation - has extremely old vines (most planted in 1947 but some are even older) on a granite-limestone soil.  It is Courbis' most dramatic wine, showing saturated black-purple in color with layers of chewy, ripe, sweet fruit with black olive and berry, tar and mineral notes. It has remarkable intensity and richness.

name: Courbis Cornas La Sabarotte 2011
notes: The La Sabarotte is Courbis' most dramatic Cornas wine, showing saturated black-purple in color with layers of chewy, ripe, sweet fruit with black olive and berry, tar and mineral notes.
