name: Dehlinger High Plains Pinot Noir 2009
notes: High Plains originates from a privileged, high-elevation section of Dehlinger vineyards planted in 1989, whose dry soils produce especially densely-flavored fruit.

name: Dehlinger Russian River Valley Pinot Noir 2003
notes: Dehlinger Pinot noirs, sourced from our estate vineyards on Vine Hill Road, are considered a reference point for the variety in the Russian River Valley. Luscious and balanced, with a striking purity of fruit, these wines capture the potential of this great winegrowing region.

name: Dehlinger Russian River Valley Pinot Noir 2005
notes: The fruit for the Pinot Noir comes from the hilltop sections of the vineyard. The wines tend to showcase darker fruit flavors and aromas of baking spices. The inclusion of a small percentage of whole clusters in the fermentation lends greater structure and aging potential to these bottling's.

name: Dehlinger Syrah 2005
notes: This high ridge of drier soil is less vigorous and produces the most concentrated wine. All of the Syrahs age in 132 gallon French oak puncheons. Twice the volume of a standard barrel, these casks permit a longer, slower maturation and a more delicate oak profile that showcases the varietal power of the wines.

name: Dehours Grande Reserve Brut
notes: Soft gold in color, the nose is dominated initially by bright citrus notes (orange zest and lemon) and ripe white fruit (pear) and yellow (apricot) and then dissolves into deeper, bottom notes of toasted brioche, apple, pine resin and wax. On the palate, sweet spices of cinnamon, vanilla and white pepper with an intense minerality give the wine an extraordinary brilliance and a taste particularly well suited for aperitifs.

name: Dei Rosso di Montepulciano 2010
notes: The Rosso di Montepulciano is a young wine with a lively ruby-red color and is full of fruity fragrances. It is dry to the taste, fresh and pleasantly tannic.

name: Dei Rosso di Montepulciano 2012
notes: The Dei Rosso di Montepulciano is blend of 80% Prugnolo gentile and 20% Canaiolo nero from 20 year old south-east facing vineyards.

name: Dei Rosso di Montepulciano 2015
notes: Bright ruby red. Fresh, fruity, cherry, plum aromas. Round, soft, quite tannic, medium bodied, quite tasty.

name: Dei Sancta Catharina Toscana 2010
notes: The Sancta Catharina is a highly concentrated wine, powerful and complex, with intense fragrances of crushed raspberry and blackberry and hints of dark chocolate. Full-bodied with velvety tannins and a long fruity finish.

name: Dei Vino Nobile di Montepulciano 2010
notes: The Vino Nobile has a bright ruby red colour and a rich texture. Refined aromas of cherry and plum follow through to a full-bodied palate, with soft, round tannins and a flavorful finish.

name: Dei Vino Nobile di Montepulciano 2012
notes: The Vino Nobile has a bright ruby red colour and a rich texture. Refined aromas of cherry and plum follow through to a full-bodied palate, with soft, round tannins and a flavourful finish.

name: Dei Vino Nobile di Montepulciano (375ML half-bottle) 2008
notes: The Vino Nobile has a bright ruby color,  intense fragrances of ripe cherries and plums  while to the taste it is dry, well-balanced and  persistent.

name: Dei Vino Nobile di Montepulciano (375ML half-bottle) 2010
notes: The Vino Nobile has a bright ruby red colour and a rich texture. Refined aromas of cherry and plum follow through to a full-bodied palate, with soft, round tannins and a flavorful finish.

name: Del Dotto Cabernet Sauvignon 1996
notes: This is a Bordeaux blend with 90% Cabernet Sauvignon, 5% Merlot and 5% Cabernet Franc.

name: Del Dotto Cabernet Sauvignon 1997
notes: Heavy bodied, nose and taste of dark cherry, berry, red licorice.

name: Del Rio Vineyards Pinot Noir 2009
notes: Our 2009 Pinot Noir has a bright ruby color and displays aromas of cherry, rosemary, and vanilla.  The nose leads to delicate violet flavors, accompanied by a structured mouthfeel that will ensure long aging.

name: Delaforce Curious and Ancient 20 Year Old Tawny Port
notes: Aged for an average of 20 years in old oak casks, the 20 Year Old is a finely balanced wine of phenomena richness and complexity. The additional 10 years of aging yields an elegant balance between the nutty honeyed finish and the vivid raisiny fruit. The 20 year old tawny is an extremely versatile dessert wine essential to complete the meal.

name: Delaforce Quinta Da Corte 1995
notes: Sensational, rich, full-bodied with a notable robust character.

name: Delaforce Ruby Port
notes: Prized for youthful vibrancy and fruit.

name: Delaforce Vintage Port 1994
notes: Ranked among the worlds greatest wines. Rich structure, concentrated flavors, extensive aging potential.

name: Delaforce Vintage Port 2003
notes: Dark, opaque, nearly black in color. Powerful black currant and berries aromas. Medium-bodied, sweet, with a good fruit and a long, satisfying finish.

name: Delaforce Vintage Port 2011
notes: Dark, opaque, nearly black in color. Powerful black currant and berries aromas. Medium-bodied, sweet, with a good fruit and a long, satisfying finish.

name: Delaforce Vintage Port (375ML half-bottle) 2003
notes: Dark, opaque, nearly black in color. Powerful black currant and berries aromas. Medium-bodied, sweet, with a good fruit and a long, satisfying finish.

name: Delaire Graff Botmaskop 2011
notes: The resulting wine is powerful, yet elegant and polished. A red blend with classic aromas of dark berry fruit, spice and cassis. The softness of tannins and balance in structure complete this wine on the palate. Optimal ageing potential of 5 – 8 years.

name: Delaire Graff Botmaskop 2013
notes: Powerful, yet elegant and polished. A red blend with classic aromas of dark berry fruit, spice and cassis. The softness of tannins and balance in structure complete this wine on the palate.

name: Delaire Graff Chenin Blanc 2013
notes: Light golden wheat color. Layered expressions of citrus andtropical fruit with subtle layers of honey and almonds in thebackground. Balanced and superbly structured, the flavours arecomplimented by a delicate minerality.

name: Delaire Graff Reserve Chardonnay 2012
notes: The 2012 conditions produced crops of notable quality. The cooler harvest period and slow ripening of grapes resulted in smaller berries with intense color, exceptional flavors and structure. This wine is elegant with layered nuances of vanilla, peaches and honeycomb. A hint of minerality adds to a lingering finish.

name: Delamotte Blanc de Blancs 2002
notes: Its color is a bright straw yellow with green hints. After an opening juicy, green apple nose come hints of white blossom, hawthorn and acacia, followed by lightly toasted notes. The initial taste is rich – a suave, creamy but refreshing wine. It is followed by peach, yellow fruit compote, the lacy feel of apple tart – with a fine persistence and a superb finish. The 2002, is an elegant, well-balanced vintage, perfectly representative of the vintage and the Mesnil-sur-Oger House.

name: Delamotte Blanc de Blancs 2004
notes: Pale gold with green reflections, there is a dense flow of fine and delicate bubbles. The nose is sharp and very fresh, nuanced and structured, with aromas of bittter oranges and orange flower. First impressions on the palate are direct and gracious with many layers of peach, yellow-fleshed fruits, mirabelle and quince that contrast with an almost salty finish.

name: Delamotte Blanc de Blancs 2007
notes: Delamotte 2007 Blanc de Blancs’ appearance reveals its inner beauty : Soft gold with green reflections whose glow is accentuated by small and numerous bubbles, forerunners to frank and pure aromas of white flowers, orange blossom and jasmine. Williams pear and a touch of spearmint complete the overall intense expression of the best Côte des Blanc Chardonnays.

name: Delamotte Blanc de Blancs Le Mesnil-sur-Oger 1997
notes: The 1997 vintage is elegant, smooth and well-rounded with fine bubbles. It shows light traces of white flowers – a must with Chardonnay – and hints of mineral that are a sure sign of exceptional aging. The balance between the aromas and flavors is perfect – both reflecting white fruit, apples and pears. After a slightly spicy nose, the palate exhibits flowers, lime blossom and honey with hints of ripe fruit reminiscent of peach, apricot and pear. The 1997 Blanc de Blancs goes well with light dishes, white meat (especially veal), fish and mild cheeses. The 1997 vintage also makes a marvelous aperitif.

name: Delamotte Brut
notes: The Delamotte Brut is a fine wine that is powerful but not aggressive, with an agreeable freshness, supple roundness on the palate and a clean and fruity finish. Pleasant, well-balanced, with a light golden color, this wine is mature and ready to drink immediately. The bouquet has a hint of citrus, white flowers, and lemon peel. The Brut is delicious as an aperitif and equally delightful with a fruit dessert.

name: Delamotte Grand Cru Blanc de Blancs Le Mesnil-sur-Oger 1999
notes: The 1999 Delamotte Blanc de Blancs is a pale yellow color with green reflects. The nose is herbal with hints of jasmine, white peach, mint, pear. On the palate, the wine is very fresh, well-balanced, straight and pure. It is the perfect companion to shellfish, crayfish carpaccio, sushi and all white fish.

name: Delas Chateauneuf-du-Pape Haute Pierre 2007
notes: Located between Avignon and Orange, wines from the Chateauneuf-du-Pape appellation are among the most prestigious of the southern Rhone. These blended wines are made from grapes grown in the region's hills with very stony soil of varying depth. The soil is comprised of red sandy clay and quartz stones. The Delas Chateauneuf-du-Pape Rouge is a negociant wine made of grapes from growers with whom the winery has worked for decades.

name: Delas Chateauneuf-du-Pape Haute Pierre 2008
notes: 90% Grenache, 10% Syrah.

name: Delas Cotes du Rhone St. Esprit Rouge 2007
notes: The Côtes-du-Rhône Saint Esprit is made from a blend of Syrah, Grenache, Mourvedre and Carignan grapes, which come from a small village in the Ardeche region. The vineyard's southern exposure on steep granite hillsides provides the best growing conditions for the vines.

name: Delas Cotes du Rhone St. Esprit Rouge 2009
region: Cotes du Rhone Villages, Rhone, France
notes: The Saint-Esprit's deep color has a dark, plum-like hue. The nose is classical Syrah, with berry fruit, violet, licorice and spices. It has a full, rounded palate with delicate tannins. Saint-Esprit is a unique wine in the Côtes-du-Rhône appellation and can be paired with Provençale-style cuisine, game, stuffings and mixed grills.

name: Delas Cotes du Rhone St. Esprit Rouge 2010
notes: The Saint-Esprit's deep color has a dark, plum-like hue. The nose is classical Syrah, with berry fruit, violet, licorice and spices. It has a full, rounded palate with delicate tannins. name: Delas Crozes-Hermitage Domaine des Grands Chemins 2009

name: Delicato Shiraz 2002
notes: Among 100 of the Best Buys reviewed, Delicato Shiraz was selected as the #1 wine in

name: DeLille Chaleur Estate Blanc 1998
notes: The aroma shows a wonderful combination of stone fruits, flint, and sweet straw.  The flavors show all the power of the 1998 vintage with a classy balance of plush ripeness and acidity.  The creamy oak nuances of the barrel fermentation seem to show up mostly in the lengthy finish.

name: DeLille Chaleur Estate Blanc 2007
notes: "Bright, full yellow with a green tinge. Pure aromas of pineapple, pear, chlorophyll and high-toned spicy oak. Bright, pure and penetrating in the mouth, with terrific density and nuance to the flavors of lime zest, minerals and coconut. For all its depth, this conveys a rare light touch. This belongs on the same table as a top-tier white Bordeaux; I was reminded of Domaine de Chevalier! One of the most exciting white wines I've tasted to date from Washington." - International Wine Cellar

name: DeLille Chaleur Estate Blanc 2009
notes: This year's Chaleur Estate Blanc reflects the warmth and size of the 2009 vintage. A rich and expressive wine featuring a complex nose of dried apricots, figs, grapefruit, flint, toasted straw and grilled bread. The mouthfeel is rich, silky and voluminous with notes of grapefruit, gooseberries, hazelnuts and toast on the finish. Although tasting great now, this vintage will develop even more character with short to mid-term cellaring.

name: DeLille Chaleur Estate Blanc 2010
notes: Sauvignon Blanc leads the way with aromas of toasted almonds, sweet straw, cardamom and other baking spices. Reminiscent of vanilla cream, guava, Meyer's lemon, pears and toasty oak tones, this wine delivers a supple, mouthwatering texture lingering on the palate long after the final sip. Superb balance, elegance, and length all contribute to a wine of timeless grace.

name: DeLille Chaleur Estate Blanc 2011
notes: Sauvignon Blanc leads the way with aromas of toasted almonds, sweet straw, cardamom and other baking spices. Reminiscent of vanilla cream, guava, Meyer's lemon, pears and toasty oak tones, this wine delivers a supple, mouthwatering texture lingering on the palate long after the final sip. Superb balance, elegance, and length all contribute to a wine of timeless grace.

name: DeLille Chaleur Estate Blanc 2012
notes: The 2012 vintage has complex aromas of sweet grasses, Bosch pears, lime citrus, pine needle sous bois (i.e. forest floor), honey suckle and fleur blanche. Accompanying these layers in the nose, there's a developing stony minerality as well. On the palate, the structure builds to rich and unctuous flavors with vibrancy. Exotic notes of star fruit, melon, kiwi, herbs, honeycomb, toast and cream are readily apparent in the mouth. A riper Chaleur Estate Blanc, this vintage finishes with power and length.

name: DeLille Chaleur Estate Blanc 2013
notes: This vintage showcases an expressive bouquet of smoky herbs, grasses, elegant white flowers and honey butter, citrus oil with nuances of creamy vanilla brioche, golden apples and toast. In the mouth there are generous proportions of star fruit, guava, meyer lemon, apples, lime leaves and cream. Reinforcing the trademark of Chaleur Estate Blanc, the wine has mouthwatering acidity, beautiful structure and balance carrying through to a lengthy finish.

name: DeLille Chaleur Estate Blanc 2014
notes: An amazing nose of sweet Sauvignon Blanc grasses and Tuscan olives supports the pastry shop aromas of almond paste, cream, hints of pineapple, star fruit, key lime pie, grapefruit and Herbs de Provence. Maybe the best descriptor is "wow!" showing flavors that are rich and expansive. It's not all about the Sauvignon Blanc though, the Semillon is evident on the palate with guava, citrus, honey and fig notes. 2014 is a vintage of classic balance and elegance reinforcing the pedigree of this wine. There is healthy structure with a lengthy finish reminding us of the greater development still to come.

name: DeLille Chaleur Estate Blanc 2015
notes: Right off the bat, there's bouquet of white pepper, lemongrass, brioche, grapefruit, caramelized pineapple and vanilla followed by sweet grass and white flowers. The mouth follows with almond butter, pineapple upside down cake, apple crisp and campfire smoke framing the dried fruit and honey. Wow, this vintage is complex and generously flavored – an outstanding Chaleur Blanc!

name: DeLille Chaleur Estate Blanc 2016
notes: This vibrant, lightly golden wine offers aromas of grapefruit, apples and pears, complimented by earthy notes of golden hay and wet stones. Offering hints of tropical fruits, apricots and candied lemon, the palate is enhanced with subtle barrel notes of light vanilla, eucalyptus and caramel, with a savory streusel character. This 2016 presents Chaleur Blanc's characteristic crisp acidity, with a noteworthy dense core of fruit that extends well into a lengthy finish.

name: DeLille Chaleur Estate Blanc 2017
notes: The 2017 introduces itself with earthy aromas of brioche and sous bois, complemented by bright apricot and peach, all with a hint of exotic tropical fruit. The golden sunlight colored wine realizes amazing tension between bright acidity and a palate weight, offering a seamless backdrop for diverse flavors of fresh straw, guava, coconut flakes and lemon zest.

name: DeLille Chaleur Estate Red 1997
notes: There is an intense nose of plums, sweet tar and black fruits along with chocolate and coffee spices.  The flavor shows deep concentration.  You have opulent black fruit notes that are nicely wrapped with grip, ripe tannins and toasty oak integration.  Perhaps it greatest attribute is its marathon finish.  This is the biggest and most concentrated Chaleur Estate to date and should have great lasting power

name: DeLille Chaleur Estate Red 2008
notes: The 2008 Chaleur Estate Red has a restrained nose of black cherry, plum, graphite, vanilla, fresh sage, thyme and white pepper. The palate is complete from front to back, boasting the high pedigree of its venerable vineyard sources along with the balance of the 2008 vintage. In the mouth, the black cherry and plum carry through from the nose augmented with rich notes of vanilla, bittersweet chocolate and espresso powder. This vintage shows the elegant side of Chaleur Estate and it's stunning, for sure. As usual, cellaring will improve this wine for years to come, though it can be hard to resist drinking now.

name: DeLille D2 Estate Red 2008
notes: In an outstanding Merlot year coupled with the addition of Red Willow Vineyard Merlot to the blend, our 2008 D2 does not disappoint and can be expected to stand out as a stellar example of the vintage. This wine has an extremely expressive nose of toasted black cherries, violets, lavender, thyme, all encapsulated in subtle mocha espresso from the oak. On the palate, rich dark fruits of blackberries and black cherries co-mingle with chocolate nuances. The 2008 D2 is extremely charming, rich and unusually complex -- a truly exceptional vintage for D2.

name: DeLille D2 Estate Red 2009
notes: The impression on the nose is immediate with aromas of fresh cherries, cinnamon, plum brandy, mocha chocolate, fennel seed and cigar box. The array of bright nuances continues on the palate with classic "Bordeaux blend" flavors of black currants, black cherries, blueberries and mint. There are also delicate hints of black pepper, brown butter and toasty oak flavors that combine with rich and juicy mouth watering balance continuing through the lengthy finish delivering yet another delicious D2 vintage.

name: DeLille D2 Estate Red 2013
notes: This exceptional vintage demonstrates classical, expressive Merlot notes of floral spices, sweet herbs, pencil shavings, tobacco pouch and mixed berries. There are rich, generous flavors filling the mouth with black cherries, raspberries and kirsch liquor as well as cocoa powder and toasty oak notes. The palate continues with savory qualities tempered by an elegance that has come to define DeLille Cellars. Complete all this with a dramatic finish to experience a memorable and youthful D2.

name: DeLille D2 Estate Red 2014
notes: The 2014 D2 has a notable dark ruby color with magenta edges. There is a proliferation of red and black fruits on the nose and palate, including blackberries, cranberries, raspberries, pomegranates, black cherries and marionberries. Wrapped around these fruit characters is a presence of mint chocolate, black olive, cedar, toasty oak and vanilla. With bright acidity and good structure, this wine is extremely well built and offers a dollop of red fruit flavors in its lengthy finish.

name: DeLille D2 Estate Red 2015
notes: Inviting pure fruit aromas of cherry, cranberry and blueberries introduce this 2015 D2, all respectfully framed by appealing oak notes of cocoa and wood spice. Soft and welcoming Merlot drives the entry with red currant before giving way to the power and structure of Cabernet Sauvignon. The fruit is well balanced with savory notes of toasted fennel seeds and dried rosemary, with enjoyable oak influence and firm tannins on the sustained finish.

name: DeLille Doyenne 2015
region: Red Mountain, Yakima Valley, Columbia Valley, Washington
notes: The 2015 vintage of Doyenne is a Red Mountain blend of 60% Syrah and 40% Cabernet Sauvignon, and as always, delivers the best of both varietals. On the nose, Syrah supplies raspberry and ripe strawberry, with Cabernet presenting dark cherry and pomegranate in strong support. A plus round entry reveals the accessibility of Syrah, countered by dense Cabernet tannin through the mid-palate and finish. The terroir of Red Mountain is well represented here, with Herbs de Provence and structure throughout.

name: DeLille Doyenne Aix 2005
notes: A red blend of 50% Cabernet Sauvignon 48% Syrah and 2% Mourvèdre.

name: DeLille Doyenne Aix 2012
region: Red Mountain, Yakima Valley, Columbia Valley, Washington
notes: Aix begins with a powerful color of deep black/purple tinted by magenta edges followed with aromas that show off an array of mixed dark fruits including black cherries, black currants, plums and blackberry jam. The nose continues with notes of violets, Herbs de Provence, ground black pepper and toasted vanilla. The flavors are vibrant and lively with good concentration showing black raspberries, dark chocolate, tobacco and sanguine meaty characteristics from the Syrah; a perfect partner for grilling.

name: DeLille Doyenne Aix 2013
region: Red Mountain, Yakima Valley, Columbia Valley, Washington
notes: Our 2013 Aix begins with a powerful color of deep black/purple tinted by magenta edges followed with aromas that show off an array of mixed dark fruits including black cherries, black currants, plums and blackberry jam. The nose continues with notes of violets, Herbs de Provence, ground black pepper and toasted vanilla. The flavors are vibrant and lively with good concentration showing black raspberries, dark chocolate, tobacco and sanguine meaty characteristics from the Syrah; a perfect partner for grilling.

name: DeLille Doyenne Roussanne 2013
region: Red Mountain, Yakima Valley, Columbia Valley, Washington
notes: The level of richness is turned up on the 2013 Roussanne. Showing all sorts of exotic fruit and spice characters, including aromas of kiwi, star fruit, wildflowers, white pepper, mint, golden apples, lime, sea salt, and toasted pine nuts. There is classic minerality and juicy lime acidity on the palate layered with Bosc pear and Golden Delicious apples. Beautifully structured with superior length, this is an excellent and powerful example of our Roussanne.

name: DeLille Doyenne Roussanne 2014
region: Red Mountain, Yakima Valley, Columbia Valley, Washington
notes: This vintage proves to be one of our most outstanding Roussanne releases to date. The nose is a complex blend of Bosc pears, white flowers, minerals, vanilla, apricot pollen and star fruit. It's a wine with assertive attack of vibrant flavors of juicy lime, agave nectar, pears, clover honey and a hint of mint in the finish. Roussanne's ability to produce big, ripe flavors yet retain its bold natural acidity is apparent here. Demonstrating tremendous depth and structure, the 2014 vintage is truly a showcase wine.

name: DeLille Doyenne Syrah 2008
notes: Our Syrah defines the 2008 vintage character beautifully -- revealing a nose of pomegranate, black raspberry, flowers, black pepper and minerals. Interesting notes of grilled meat and wet stones accompany the usual Syrah flavors of black plum, pomegranate, and fresh herbs. Demonstrating uncommon elegance, balance and power, the finish is focused and long. This wine continues the 2008 trend of interesting, elegant wines with classical structure and memorable longevity.

name: DeLille Doyenne Syrah 2009
notes: This Syrah defines the vintage character beautifully, revealing a nose of pomegranate, black raspberry, flowers, black pepper and minerals. Interesting notes of grilled meat and wet stones accompany the usual Syrah flavors of black plum, pomegranate, and fresh herbs. Demonstrating uncommon elegance, balance and power, the finish is focused and long. This wine continues the trend of interesting, elegant wines with classical structure and memorable longevity.

name: DeLille Doyenne Syrah 2010
notes: This Syrah defines the 2008 vintage character beautifully -- revealing a nose of pomegranate, black raspberry, flowers, black pepper and minerals. Interesting notes of grilled meat and wet stones accompany the usual Syrah flavors of black plum, pomegranate, and fresh herbs. Demonstrating uncommon elegance, balance and power, the finish is focused and long. This wine continues the 2008 trend of interesting, elegant wines with classical structure and memorable longevity.

name: DeLille Doyenne Syrah 2012
notes: This is a complex and multi-dimensional Syrah expressing blackberries, raspberries, and blueberries sprinkled with cocoa power, black pepper, lavender, cedar and tangerine notes. On the palate there is subtle minerality among all the fresh berries. Rich and powerful, the 2012 vintage of our Syrah is defined by great lift and outstanding proportion.

name: DeLille Doyenne Syrah 2013
notes: Showing qualities of crushed stones and deep, dark fruits like  boysenberry, blackberries, cracked pepper and black olive, this is  a very European-style Syrah.  In addition, exotic notes of burnt citrus, freshly crushed vanilla bean, red apricots and new leather enhance the dark fruit core.  Although this vintage is young and muscular, generous flavors are already developing and filling the mouth giving a hint of what is to come, a very complex Syrah.

name: DeLille Four Flags Cabernet Sauvignon 2013
region: Red Mountain, Yakima Valley, Columbia Valley, Washington
notes: This vintage has powerful yet harmonious fruit and oak balance. Classically structured with great lift, the 2013 Four Flags includes rich cassis, black cherries and pine nut nuances. Add savory ripe tannins, toasty oak, exotic spices of coriander and cardamom along with a smoky texture and you can see how complex and dynamic it is right now. Equally important, there are clues as to where this wine is headed as it develops over the next decade.

name: DeLille Four Flags Cabernet Sauvignon 2016
region: Red Mountain, Yakima Valley, Columbia Valley, Washington
notes: The fruit aromas of the 2016 Four Flags are fresh and focused, with blueberry, red currant and pomegranate mingling with barrel notes of cocoa nibs and wood smoke.  Sourced solely from Red Mountain Cabernet Sauvignon, this wine beautifully showcases the typicity of the AVA, with inviting notes of cedar, lavender and bay leaf. The palate offers generous flavors, with chocolate covered cherries and tapenade carried by fresh acidity.  Ample, fine-grained tannins carry the flavors through a lengthy finish, promising many years of graceful aging.

name: DeLille Harrison Hill Red 1997
notes: Floral violet notes, elegant layers of fruit, refinement and sweet oak are all included in this wine's aroma.  This is an expressive wine.  Black cherries and elegance have always been this vineyard's trademark and is very much involved here. There is also a cupboard of herbs and spices.  Delicious, balanced and long lived.

name: DeLille Harrison Hill Red 2001
notes: As per the '01 vintage, this year's Harrison Hill is riper, darker and more concentrated than usual. There still are the wonderful layers of leather,black cherries and fresh herbs.

name: DeLille Harrison Hill Red 2002
notes: A big Harrison Hill vintage with aromas of deep black fruits, meatiness, leather, five-spices, ripe herbs and violets.

name: DeLille Harrison Hill Red 2004
notes: Blend: 65% Cabernet Sauvignon, 25% Merlot, 9% Cabernet Franc, 1% Petit Verdot

name: Delinquente Tuff Nutt Pet Nat 2019
notes: The nose is beautifully clean for a bottle fermented wine, bright citrus mixed with bready, almost croissant-like aromas. The palate this vintage opens tight and fresh, before giving way to the classic tropical fruit characters of lychee, honeydew and pineapple that we have come to expect from this wine. The acid line cuts through this fruitiness, giving the wine an almost savory, moreish finish.

name: DeLoach Barbieri Zinfandel 2000
notes: De Loach Vineyards Barbieri Ranch Zinfandel expresses the rich fruit and vibrant spice of the varietal. The wine offers intense black fruit and vanilla oak aromas and an inviting sweetness on the soft palate. Flavors of blackberry, blueberry and spice come together in this rich and flavorful wine. Cedar overtones follow in the long, jammy finish. This Zinfandel is youthful, full-bodied and very sumptuous, with firm acidity. It will age well.

name: DeLoach Barbieri Zinfandel 2001
notes: De Loach Vineyards Barbieri Ranch Zinfandel expresses the rich fruit and vibrant spice of the varietal. The wine offers intense black fruit and vanilla oak aromas and an inviting sweetness on the soft palate. Flavors of blackberry, blueberry and spice come together in this rich and flavorful wine. Cedar overtones follow in the long, jammy finish. This Zinfandel is youthful, full-bodied and very sumptuous, with firm acidity. It will age well.

name: DeLoach California Zinfandel 1999
notes: Our 1999 California Zinfandel is a bright, deep ruby color, with intense varietal fruit balanced by toasty oak.  The wine has a fragrant nose of strawberry-rhubard pie, and red berry aromas.  On the palate, plum, raspberry and cranberry flavors are complimented by hints of spice and oak.  This wine is balanced and full-bodied with a bright, clean finish.

name: DeLoach Central Coast Pinot Noir 2012
notes: Ruby in color, this wine showcases aromas and flavors of juicy fruit such as strawberry and red cherries, with a hint of gingerbread. With a well-balanced structure, this wine is medium in body and has a nice long finish.

name: DeLoach Estate Chardonnay 2014
notes: The 2014 Estate Vineyard Chardonnay is a rich golden honey color in the glass and offers seductive aromas of Fuji apple, tangerine and baked fruit crisp with a touch of floral perfume. Full, rich flavors of mandarins, Asian pear, nutmeg and vanilla spread softly across the palate with a supple, silky mouthfeel. This medium plus bodied wine presents moderate acidity and beautiful balance with an opulent finish.

name: DeLoach Estate Chardonnay 2015
notes: With a rich golden honey color in the glass, the 2015 Estate Chardonnay opens with enticing aromas of musk melon, Fuji apple, and a touch of floral perfume. Warm, full flavors of Asian pear and nutmeg spread across the palate creating a wonderfully rich white wine. With a silky mouthfeel and moderate acidity this wine pairs flawlessly with any meal.

name: DeLoach Estate Pinot Noir 1998
notes: De Loach Vineyards 1998 Estate Bottled Pinot Noir is a well-balanced wine, with aromas of cherries, black currants, spice and cream. Deep fruit flavors are followed by hints of cinnamon and toasty oak. The wine is smooth and luscious in the mouth, with a medium body and an elegant finish.  This wine is an excellent compliment to mushrooms, grilled quail with a fruit reduction sauce, and rich salmon dishes.

name: DeLoach Estate Pinot Noir 1999
notes: De Loach Vineyards 1999 Estate Bottled Pinot Noir is a rich, complex and elegant wine, with aromas of ripe berries and spice. On the palate, flavors of dark cherries and black currant mingle with hints of chocolate, spice and toasted oak. This wine is smooth and luscious in the mouth, with medium body and a long finish.

name: DeLoach Estate Pinot Noir 2013
notes: The 2013 Estate Vineyard Pinot Noir aromatically opens with ripe red fruits heightened with hints of soft baking spice and candied orange peel. The deep aromas lead to enticing flavors ofcheery cola balanced with the earthiness of Shitake mushroom. Its full body, and round, rich velvety feel lead to a long, satisfying finish.

name: DeLoach Estate Pinot Noir 2014
notes: The 2014 Estate Vineyard Pinot Noir is bursting with aromas of dark fruits, rose petal and a touch of white pepper. Complex flavors of cherry, candied orange peel and a touch of Shitake mushroom and soft baking spices coat the palate. Full bodied and richly flavored, this velvety wine leads to a long, satisfying finish.

name: DeLoach Forgotten Vines Zinfandel 2011
notes: Dark purple in color, this delicious Zinfandel features aromas and flavors of dark cherry and blackberry intermingled with exotic fruits such as guava and a touch of black pepper on the nose. The firm structure accompanied with the sweet oak influence leads to elegant tannins, a velvety mouthfeel and a long, lingering finish.

name: DeLoach Forgotten Vines Zinfandel 2013
notes: Forgotten Vines Zinfandel opens brilliantly with bright fruit aromatics that are complemented by hints of warm spice and cocoa. Flavors of blackberry, blueberry, currant, tobacco and milk chocolate envelope the palate and lead to an opulent, smooth finish that makes this wine the perfect accompaniment to a variety of barbecue.

name: DeLoach Gambogi Zinfandel 1999
notes: Our 1999 Gambogi Ranch Zinfandel displays a dark, deep garnet color and classic brambly aromas. Raspberry, chocolate and spice mingle together in this rich and flavorful wine. Its big, firm structure accentuates vibrant fruit and oak. This elegant wine offers layers of complexity, firm tannins and a long finish.

name: DeLoach Gambogi Zinfandel 2000
notes: Our Gambogi Ranch Zinfandel displays a dark, deep garnet color and classic brambly aromas. Raspberry, chocolate and spice mingle together in this rich and flavorful wine. Its big, firm structure accentuates vibrant fruit and oak. This elegant wine offers layers of complexity, firm tannins and a long finish.

name: DeLoach Gambogi Zinfandel 2001
notes: Our Gambogi Ranch Zinfandel displays a dark, deep garnet color and classic brambly aromas. Raspberry, chocolate and spice mingle together in this rich and flavorful wine. Its big, firm structure accentuates vibrant fruit and oak. This elegant wine offers layers of complexity, firm tannins and a long finish.

name: DeLoach Green Valley Pinot Noir 2008
region: Green Valley, Russian River, Sonoma County, California
notes: In the western hills of the Russian River Valley, the small Green Valley appellation is one of Sonoma County's coolest regions. Evening fog blankets push over from the Pacific Ocean to temper the warm summer days. These optimal conditions extend the growing season, encouraging flavor concentration in the berries while soils rich in minerals from an ancient seabed infuse the fruit with nuanced flavors.

name: DeLoach Green Valley Pinot Noir 2009
region: Green Valley, Russian River, Sonoma County, California
notes: Enticingly aromatic, with notes of raspberries, black cherries, rhubarb, rose petals and a hint of cola.

name: DeLoach Green Valley Pinot Noir 2010
region: Green Valley, Russian River, Sonoma County, California
notes: Complex and enticingly aromatic, bursting with notes of raspberries, strawberry-rhubarb pie, plum and black cherries with traces of pine duff and lavender. With a rich fruit palate, a fine-grained medium body and long finish, this wine is excellent alone or with grilled salmon or a seared duck breast with a blackcurrant glaze.

name: DeLoach Green Valley Pinot Noir 2013
region: Green Valley, Russian River, Sonoma County, California
notes: The 2013 Green Valley Pinot Noir opens with fragrant aromas of bright cherry and currants with a hint of orange zest, enticing the palate. Complex flavors of blueberry, raspberry, vanilla and a touch of white pepper richly coat the palate. Full-bodied and spreading, the velvety, round mouthfeel of this wine leads to a long, satisfying finish.

name: DeLoach Heritage Reserve Chardonnay 2015
notes: Nicely integrated citrus and honey notes that intertwine perfectly with tropical flavors of pineapple, papaya and mango.

name: DeLoach Heritage Reserve Chardonnay 2018
notes: Nicely integrated notes of orange blossom and creamy honeydew melon. Tropical flavors of pineapple, papaya and mango. This wine is delightfully balanced with bright acidity and a long finish that makes it the perfect complement to a wide variety of cuisines.

name: DeLoach Heritage Reserve Pinot Noir 2009
notes: This Pinot Noir is light ruby in color, with aromas of strawberry jam and a touch of mint, almost "Beaujolais" in style. To the taste, Queen Anne cherries, pomegranate, and cranberry are the primary flavors, with a hint of tobacco to round out the palate. The wine is light in body, with a medium finish, and pairs well with lighter entrees, including grilled sea bass or chicken Caesar salad.

name: DeLoach Maboroshi Vineyard Pinot Noir 2006
notes: Nestled in the Sonoma Coast hills southwest of Sebastopol, the Maboroshi vineyard lies at 600 ft elevation, and is one of the first spots to clear from the morning fog as ridges to the west shelter the site from any lingering marine layer.  Fine Goldridge loam nurtures the vines, and the Kisaichi family meticulously tends to them using sustainable methods.

name: DeLoach O.F.S. Cabernet Sauvignon (1.5L) 1996
notes: De Loach Vineyards 1996 Cabernet Sauvignon O.F.S. displays a rich ruby color and an elegant nose of ripe plum, black cassis, chocolate, and smoke. Cassis flavors resonate on the palate, followed by layers of chocolate and cedar. This lush wine is full-bodied and sumptuous with a hint of tobacco in the finish.

name: DeLoach O.F.S. Cabernet Sauvignon 1996
notes: De Loach Vineyards 1996 Cabernet Sauvignon O.F.S. displays a rich ruby color and an elegant nose of ripe plum, black cassis, chocolate, and smoke. Cassis flavors resonate on the palate, followed by layers of chocolate and cedar. This lush wine is full-bodied and sumptuous with a hint of tobacco in the finish.

name: DeLoach O.F.S. Chardonnay (1.5L) 1998
notes: De Loach Vineyards 1998 Chardonnay O.F.S. is extremely rich and full-bodied with a bouquet of mango, butterscotch and vanilla followed by toasty oak aromas.  This elegant wine is full-bodied with a smooth, long lasting finish.

name: DeLoach O.F.S. Chardonnay 1998
notes: De Loach Vineyards 1998 Chardonnay O.F.S. is extremely rich and full-bodied with a bouquet of mango, butterscotch and vanilla followed by toasty oak aromas.  This elegant wine is full-bodied with a smooth, long lasting finish.

name: DeLoach O.F.S. Chardonnay 2011
notes: The 2011 OFS Chardonnay is a balanced, complex wine that reflects the best characteristics of each of the vineyards that contribute to the final blend. The 2011 vintage opens with a bouquet of white peach and light citrus rind with notes of California apricot that are accented with just a hint of vanilla bean. The wine is medium-to-full bodied with a delightful mouthfeel that highlights flavors of Fuji apple and pineapple while featuring a layered complexity, fine acid balance and a lengthy finish.

name: DeLoach O.F.S. Chardonnay 2015
notes: This Chardonnay reveals notes of freshly shaved ginger, marzipan and pie crust over a core of spiced pears, Golden Delicious apples and honeydew melon. Medium to full-bodied, it features spice-laced apple and pear flavors with a pleasantly oily texture and an invigorating finish.

name: DeLoach O.F.S. Pinot Noir 1999
notes: De Loach Vineyards 1999 Pinot Noir O.F.S. displays a deep garnet color with dark cherry and berry fruit in the nose. On the palate, rich fruit overtones are complemented by a slight smokiness, a hint of spice and layers of creamy cola notes. This wine is lush with a medium body, a sumptuous mouthfeel and an elegant, lingering finish. Sit and explore the evolution of flavors this Pinot Noir offers in the glass.

name: DeLoach O.F.S. Pinot Noir 2008
notes: The OFS (Our Finest Selection) Pinot Noir typifies a quintessential Pinot Noir from the Russian River Valley. Generous aromas of blackberry and raspberry lift out of the glass. The aromas unfold to fresh berries mingling with rose petals towards the front of the palate, followed by undertones of cola, leather, and black tea in the mid to back palate. This seductively layered wine is perfectly balanced with its fine acids and medium bodied soft tannins, resulting in a wine that is approachable upon release as well as a wine that will continue to develop beautiful nuances with age. Enjoy with roasted port tenderloin with fingerling potatoes or grilled rack of lamb with honey mustard glaze.

name: DeLoach O.F.S. Pinot Noir 2011
notes: The 2011 OFS Pinot Noir is a prime example of the quintessential Russian River Valley Pinot Noir from a colder growing season. The aromas and flavors of pomegranate, cranberry, rose petals and savory herbs are complimented by underlying minerality and sweet oak. With medium body, silky texture and complexity, this delicious wine will develop beautifully in the bottle.

name: DeLoach O.F.S. Pinot Noir 2012
notes: The 2012 OFS Pinot Noir is a prime example of the quintessential Russian River Valley Pinot Noir. The wine opens with ripe, red fruit aromas that lead seamlessly into striking flavors of raspberry, cherry, red currant and just a hint of sautéed wild mushrooms. With balanced acidity and a silky texture, this is a wine that is immediately enjoyable but sure to provide the palate pleasure for years to come.

name: DeLoach O.F.S. Pinot Noir 2013
notes: Ruby colored in the glass, the 2013 OFS Pinot Noir opens with aromas of red fruit and star anise. Upon the palate, flavors of dark cherry, orange peel, raspberry and a touch of clove bring together this medium bodied wine. Nice acidity and medium plus length ensure that this is an immediately enjoyable Pinot Noir.

name: DeLoach O.F.S. Pinot Noir 2015
notes: The quintessential Russian River Pinot Noir, the 2015 O.F.S. Pinot Noir opens with notes of pomegranate and orange zest with star anise. Mouthwatering flavors of cranberry, blueberry, and black currant are accented with a touch of baker's chocolate leading to a clean finish. Medium bodied with bright acidity.

name: DeLoach O.F.S. Zinfandel 1999
notes: A winemaker favorite, De Loach Vineyards 1999 Zinfandel O.F.S. displays a deep ruby color and dark chocolate and blackberry aromas. This wine has a velvety smooth entry into the palate followed with layers of fruit and spice. The long, lingering finish echoes flavors of blackberry, chocolate and spice. This wine is big, rich and sumptuous.

name: DeLoach O.F.S. Zinfandel 2001
notes: A winemaker favorite, De Loach Vineyards Zinfandel O.F.S. displays a deep ruby color and dark chocolate and blackberry aromas. This wine has a velvety smooth entry into the palate followed with layers of fruit and spice. The long, lingering finish echoes flavors of blackberry, chocolate and spice. This wine is big, rich and sumptuous.

name: DeLoach O.F.S. Zinfandel 2007
notes: O.F.S. stands for Our Finest Selection; it is blended from our favorite barrels of Russian River Valley fruit to create an extremely high-quality, unique wine that showcases the appellation's character.

name: DeLoach Papera Ranch Zinfandel 1999
notes: De Loach Vineyards 1999 Papera Ranch Zinfandel displays a rich ruby color and forward aromas of cranberry and raspberry with a hint of vanilla.  Sweet cherry flavors on the palate are accented by a perfect balance of vanilla and spice.  The wine is lively and bright, with a smooth, silky mouthfeel with undertones of smoke and toast in the finish.

notes: De Loach Vineyards Papera Ranch Zinfandel displays a rich ruby color and forward aromas of cranberry and raspberry with a hint of vanilla. The wine is lively and bright, with a smooth, silky mouthfeel with undertones of smoke and toast in the finish.

The wine is lively and bright, with a smooth, silky mouthfeel with undertones of smoke and toast in the finish.

name: DeLoach Pelletti Zinfandel 2000
notes: Our Pelletti Ranch Zinfandel displays a deep ruby purple color and aromas of fresh ripe boysenberry, mulberry and chocolate. The intense berry flavors are enhanced by oak aging, creating a mouth filling, juicy wine. The finish is huge and lasting, with hints of pepper and spice. Food Pairings: Pork Tenderloin with Raspberry Reduction Sauce,  Tomato & Black Olive Risotto and Pizza with Pepperoni, Sausage and Mushrooms

name: DeLoach Pinot Noir Balletto Ranch 1999
notes: De Loach Vineyards 1999 Balletto Ranch Pinot Noir has a beautiful color with aromas of ripe cherry and spice. Flavors of wild strawberry, cherry, toast and vanilla are the focus of this complex wine. The mouth feel is elegant and silky, with medium body and smooth finish.

name: DeLoach Russian River Chardonnay 1998
notes: De Loach Vineyards 1998 Russian River Valley Chardonnay displays distinctive characteristics true to the appellation; rich, ripe fruit and firm acidity. Its concentrated aromas of pear, apple and vanilla are complemented nicely by toasty oak components. This elegant wine is full-bodied with a smooth, long-lasting finish. This wine is a wonderful match with seafood. We recommend pairing it with lobster, monkfish or shrimp scampi. Our favorite match is with seared scallops on a bed of truffled mashed potatoes.

name: DeLoach Russian River Chardonnay 2010
notes: The 2010 vintage of this Chardonnay was crafted from a blend of grapes from premium vineyards in the heart of the Russian River Valley. Carefully tended vines yield fruit of exemplary quality: a pure expression of the valley's terroir. The cool foggy mornings are tempered by luxuriously warm afternoons to achieve fruit maturity without loss of depth or suppleness.

name: DeLoach Russian River Chardonnay 2012
notes: Beautiful pale straw yellow in color, the nose of this Chardonnay immediately entices you with its rich aromas of key lime, white peach, and baked apple pie. Upon the first sip, you will surprised by the flinty brightness that balances the apple creaminess. The hint of soft oak helps carry this lovely wine with a long, lingering finish.

name: DeLoach Russian River Chardonnay 2013
notes: Our 2013 offering effortlessly combines the two distinct styles of crisp refinement and rich elegance. Inviting aromas of ripe Asian pear and honey suckle flowers are intertwined with layers of tangerine. Nutmeg and muskmelon are displayed on the palate and are complemented with flavors of vanilla cream and baking spice.

name: DeLoach Russian River Chardonnay 2014
notes: The 2014 Russian River Chardonnay offers enticing aromas of Asian pear, white floral notes and a touch of tangerine. Upon the palate, fresh flavors of white peach and muskmelon are beautifully complemented by nutmeg and a touch of vanilla. Creamy and rich upon the palate, a distinct crisp finish makes this enjoyable with a variety of light dishes.

name: DeLoach Russian River Chardonnay 2015
notes: A delightful straw yellow color in the glass, the 2015 Chardonnay entices the senses with aromas of key lime and white peach with a hint of sweet honeysuckle. Layered flavors of baked apple, Asian pear and vanilla creme are balanced with a touch of flinty brightness that leads to a long, clean finish.

name: DeLoach Russian River Chardonnay 2016
notes: A delightful straw yellow color in the glass, this Chardonnay entices the senses with aromas of key lime and white peach with a hint of sweet honeysuckle. Layered flavors of baked apple, Asian pear and vanilla creme are balanced with a touch of flinty brightness that leads to a long, clean finish. This Chardonnay pairs well with a variety of light dishes and effortlessly combines the two distinct styles of crisp refinement and rich elegance.

name: DeLoach Russian River Chardonnay (half-bottle) 1998
notes: De Loach Vineyards 1998 Russian River Valley Chardonnay displays distinctive characteristics true to the appellation; rich, ripe fruit and firm acidity. Its concentrated aromas of pear, apple and vanilla are complemented nicely by toasty oak components. This elegant wine is full-bodied with a smooth, long-lasting finish. This wine is a wonderful match with seafood. We recommend pairing it with lobster, monkfish or shrimp scampi. Our favorite match is with seared scallops on a bed of truffled mashed potatoes.

name: DeLoach Russian River Estate Pinot Noir 2006
notes: The wine offers aromas of black cherries, violets and a touch of cinnamon combined with subtle notes of French oak and cola followed by an incredibly silky texture that glides across the palate.

name: DeLoach Russian River Estate Pinot Noir 2007
notes: Ripe raspberries lift from the glass and mingle with tempting aromas of strawberry-rhubarb tart and cola. Delicate notes of anise, cardamom and gingerbread spice lace the fruit to unfold a rich palate of black cherries supported by medium-fine-grained tannins. The finish lingers with attractive, subtle, toasty undertones, fine acid, and excellent balance.

name: DeLoach Russian River Estate Pinot Noir 2008
notes: The cool, foggy Russian River Valley climate allows for slow ripening, enabling grapes to develop full flavor maturation over an extended time. The fruit for our 2008 blend was hand-harvested from select vineyards around the valley and processed using traditional Burgundian techniques: small open-top tank fermentation, hand punch-downs, basket-pressing and French oak barrel ageing.

name: DeLoach Russian River Estate Pinot Noir 2009
notes: The cool, foggy Russian River Valley climate allows for slow ripening, enabling grapes to develop full flavor maturation over an extended time. To create our 2009 Russian River Valley Pinot Noir, grapes were hand-harvested from our vineyards.

name: DeLoach Russian River Fume Blanc 1999
notes: Our 1999 Fume Blanc combines authentic Sauvignon Blanc flavors with toasty oak components. The wine is lively and crisp with aromas of pineapple, pear and orange-blossom. Flavors of pineapple, Asian pear and grapefruit mingle on the palate with hints of spice. Toasty oak components add a creaminess to the finish.

name: DeLoach Russian River Pinot Noir 2013
notes: Our 2013 Russian River Valley Pinot Noir opens with enchanting sweet red fruit aromas softly accentuated by darker spice notes. This silky wine drapes the palate, enticing with flavors of cherry, plum and rhubarb preserves while displaying the perfect balance of structure and acidity common to the Russian River Valley.

name: DeLoach Russian River Pinot Noir 2015
notes: A delightful ruby color in the glass, the 2015 Russian River Valley Pinot Noir offers aromas of sweet red fruits with hints of vanilla. Flavors of cherry, raspberry, plum and clove mingle upon the palate, displaying balanced structure, medium body, and moderate tannins. Made to be immediately enjoyable, this wine is a perfect accompaniment to wood-fired pizza or mushroom risotto.

name: DeLoach Russian River Pinot Noir (375ML half-bottle) 2007
notes: Ripe raspberries lift from the glass and mingle with tempting aromas of strawberry-rhubarb tart and cola. Delicate notes of anise, cardamom and gingerbread spice lace the fruit to unfold a rich palate of black cherries supported by medium-fine-grained tannins. The finish lingers with attractive, subtle, toasty undertones, fine acid, and excellent balance.

name: DeLoach Russian River Sauvignon Blanc 2006
notes: Nose: Delicious aromas of melon, passion fruit and dry grass.

name: DeLoach Russian River Zinfandel 2001
notes: The smell is incredibly delicious. There is a combination of ripe boysenberry, mulberry, and chocolate. The wine is mouth-filling on the palate with the rich fruit balanced by bright acidity. The finish is berry berry long with hints of pepper and spice.

name: DeLoach Russian River Zinfandel 2003
notes: Using estate grapes and selected fruit from growers in the Russian River Valley, the "Russian River Valley" series of wines represent the "heart and soul" of Deloach Vineyard's offerings. Consistently award wining and satisfying, the wines exhibit an elegant fruit-forward flavor profile unique to this appelation.

name: DeLoach Russian River Zinfandel 2007
notes: Aromas of cherry and raspberry lift from the glass, followed by notes of spice and pine duff. Brambly boysenberry notes linger on the palate as juicy cranberry layers mingle with black peppery hints of autumn forest. Medium bodied and fresh, this wine unfolds with a wonderful balance of acidity and lush tannins leading to a long finish. Robust and high-toned, this wine will drink beautifully for years to come.

name: DeLoach Russian River Zinfandel 2008
notes: Aromas of cherry and raspberry lift from the glass, followed by notes of spice and pine duff. Brambly boysenberry notes linger on the palate as juicy cranberry layers mingle with black peppery hints of autumn forest. Medium bodied and fresh, this wine unfolds with a wonderful balance of acidity and lush tannins leading to a long finish. Robust and high-toned, this wine will drink beautifully for years to come.

name: DeLoach Russian River Zinfandel 2009
notes: The nose on this wine is high-toned and full of plum, blackberry and blueberry with hints of red currant and black pepper. Dark red, almost purplish, this wine is full-bodied with excellent structure. This Zinfandel, true to its varietal, is well-balanced, has good acidity, and a touch of toast and fruit on the palate.

name: DeLoach Russian River Zinfandel 2010
notes: Aromas of cherry and raspberry lift from the glass, followed by notes of spice and pine duff. Brambly boysenberry notes linger on the palate as juicy cranberry layers mingle with black peppery hints of autumn forest.

name: DeLoach Russian River Zinfandel 2012
notes: The wine opens aromatically with enticing notes full of boysenberry and blackberry accentuated with hints of dust and violet. Dark red, almost purplish, this wine is medium to full-bodied with excellent balance and greatstructure. True to its varietal, our Russian River ValleyZinfandel has nice acidity, just a touch of toast on the palate and is ready to be enjoyed upon release.

name: DeLoach Russian River Zinfandel 2013
notes: The wine opens aromatically with enticing notes full of boysenberry and blackberry accentuated with hints of dust and violet. Dark red, almost purplish, this wine is medium to full-bodied with excellent balance and great structure. True to its varietal, our Russian River Valley Zinfandel has nice acidity, just a touch of toast on the palate and is ready to be enjoyed upon release.

name: DeLoach Russian River Zinfandel 2014
notes: Opening with aromatically rich notes of blackberry, brambles and a hint of pepper, our 2014 Russian River Zinfandel is sure to entice the senses. Upon the palate, flavors of roasted peaches and boysenberry are complemented with violets and a touch of dust. This wine is medium bodied with nice, balanced acidity and great structure, sure to be an instant favorite!

name: DeLoach Saitone Zinfandel 1999
notes: De Loach Vineyards 1999 Saitone Ranch Zinfandel is full of ripe black fruit from our oldest vines. The wine is bright and crisp with cherry and blackberry aromas and flavors, accented by a perfect balance of smoke and spice. This jammy Zinfandel is layered and full in the mouth, with a long spicy finish. While delicious now, this wine will age well for those with the patience to cellar it.

name: DeLoach Saitone Zinfandel 2000
notes: De Loach Vineyards Saitone Ranch Zinfandel is full of ripe black fruit from our oldest vines. The wine is bright and crisp with cherry and blackberry aromas and flavors, accented by a perfect balance of smoke and spice. This jammy Zinfandel is layered and full in the mouth, with a long spicy finish. While delicious now, this wine will age well for those with the patience to cellar it.

name: DeLoach Saitone Zinfandel 2001
notes: De Loach Vineyards Saitone Ranch Zinfandel is full of ripe black fruit from our oldest vines. The wine is bright and crisp with cherry and blackberry aromas and flavors, accented by a perfect balance of smoke and spice. This jammy Zinfandel is layered and full in the mouth, with a long spicy finish. While delicious now, this wine will age well for those with the patience to cellar it.

name: DeLoach Van der Kamp Vineyard Pinot Noir 2009
notes: The nose on this Pinot Noir is complex yet pleasing with aromas of berry fruit, brown spice and earth. Flavors of strawberry-rhubarb, cardamom, cinnamon, pine duff and peat meld together to complete this rich and enjoyable wine. With a medium body, this wine is very smooth and wide on the palate. The tannins are full and the finish is long with juicy red fruits.

name: DeLoach Von Weildlich Vineyard Zinfandel 2008
notes: Offering aromas of red berry pie laced with exotic spices, this Zinfandel is lush and elegant with delightful hints of mineral and spice. Medium bodied with lower alcohol and a lighter style, this juicy, fruit forward Zinfandel dances on the palate with flavors of blackberry bramble and subtle notes of crushed minerals. Excellent with wine-braised chicken with shallots and olives, eggplant parmesan or flank steak stuffed with proscuitto and red peppers.

name: Demetria Estate Pinot Noir Cuvee Sandra 2006
notes: Layers of cherry, strawberry, black truffle, and cola are complimented by spice and graphite. Rich and complex, with flavors of deep red fruits, leather, and smoke on the palate. Long, lingering finish. The perfect pinot to compliment red meats, especially lamb.

name: Denis Mortet Chambolle-Musigny Aux Beaux Bruns Premier Cru 2015
region: Chambolle-Musigny, Cote de Nuits, Cote d'Or, Burgundy, France
notes: Situated on the lower part of the village, facing east, "Aux Beaux Bruns" vineyard is composed of powdery limestone soil, and plenty of white marl. It has a fine stony layer on the surface offering good drainage.

name: Denis Mortet Gevrey-Chambertin Lavaux St-Jacques Premier Cru 2015
region: Gevrey-Chambertin, Cote de Nuits, Cote d'Or, Burgundy, France
notes: The 1er Cru Lavaux St-Jacques vineyard has an uneven and gentle slope which allows for excellent natural drainage. The vines benefit from maximum sunshine throughout the day and cool down considerably during the evening. This contrast in temperature is well-suited for growing Pinot Noir.

name: Denis Mortet Gevrey-Chambertin Les Champeaux Premier Cru 2015
region: Gevrey-Chambertin, Cote de Nuits, Cote d'Or, Burgundy, France
notes: With a very specific climate, the "Champeaux" vineyard is surrounded by dried stone walls and winegrowers’ shelters. The old vines are planted on deep stony terraces composed of particularly red soil with violet colored veins.

name: Denis Mortet Gevrey-Chambertin Premier Cru 2015
region: Gevrey-Chambertin, Cote de Nuits, Cote d'Or, Burgundy, France
notes: This is without a doubt Denis Mortet’s most charming Gevrey-Chambertin. Its straight forward nature immediately reveals velvet fruitiness with a touch of spice and smoke. Delicious after just a couple of years in the cellar.

name: Denis Mortet Marsannay Les Longeroies 2015
region: Marsannay, Cote de Nuits, Cote d'Or, Burgundy, France
notes: "Les Longeroies" originates from an old French word meaning "furrow". The vineyard faces south and is situated in the middle slope which is comprised of limestone scree resting over deep soils.

name: Denner Grenache 2017
region: Willow Creek District, Paso Robles, Central Coast, California
notes: A powerful nose filled with notes of raspberry, Bing cherry, and black pepper is backed up by honey and jasmine accents. Flavors of spicy fruit compote, chipotle and anise evolve into round, silky tannins. The beautifully dense, yet elegant mid-palate flows seamlessly into an impressively long finish.

name: Denner Paso Robles Syrah 2003
notes: Has aromas of brilliant blackberries, raspberry and a touch of nutmeg. It is big, lush, ripe and intense on the palate with a long beautifully well-balanced finish.

name: Denner Paso Robles Syrah 2005
notes: Opens up with notes of tar, roasted game, espresso, and ripe boysenberry/pomegranate on the nose. These dark, brooding elements follow through on the palate and are buttressed by ample, ripe tannins and a long, spicy boysenberry finish.

name: Denner Syrah 2016
notes: Stunning aromatics composed of blueberry, sarsaparilla, petunias, and chaparral invite you into this truly hedonistic wine. Flavors of dark chocolate, French roast, duck confit, and olive tapenade temper the exuberant fruit notes on the palate. The finish exhibits both richness and purity, showcasing an opulent mid-palate that is focused with tannins reminiscent of wellworn leather.

name: Denner The Ditch Digger 2004
notes: The 2004 Denner The Ditch Digger displays upfront aromas of raspberries, minerality, white pepper, dark chocolate, and spice. On the palate, the jammy fruit and pepper elements from the Grenache and Syrah are counter-balanced by the dark, meaty, brooding beast that is Mourvedre. The smooth tannins and balanced acidity slowly draw the curtain on the long, spicey finish.

name: Denner Viognier 2017
region: Willow Creek District, Paso Robles, Central Coast, California
notes: Juicy peach, lemon oil and orange marmalade are supported with hints of flint and mineral notes. The palate is full-bodied, with flavors of nectarine, buttered brioche and honey. The rich, complex flavors are cut with a touch of tannin and bright acidity on the long fresh finish.

name: Denner Zinfandel 2012
notes: Like a beautiful rose garden, this Zin seems harmless enough - flaunting an ethereal nose of potpourri, black raspberry, 5-spice and sweet bay. But soon it pricks your palate with black fruits, orange peel, underbrush and chocolate.  After making known its dangers it finishes with seductive tannins begging you to reach for it once again.

name: Deovlet Bien Nacido Vineyard Pinot Noir 2014
region: Santa Maria Valley, Central Coast, California
notes: A beautifully floral nose lifted with rose petal, cinnamon, pine, blood orange, cranberry, and black cherries. Perfectly ripe tannins provide structure and impressive depth. The quality shows through instantly, and insiders are saying this vintage is even better than the last. Get it while you can!

name: Deovlet La Encantada Vineyard Pinot Noir 2012
notes: Deep ruby color and wonderfully aromatic with perfume of black raspberry, black cherry, spice, and leather. The palate consistently offers a charming purity of fruit with refined tannins and a solid structure. This is an elegant and complex offering which shows richness when young, certain to evolve beautifully in bottle.

name: Deovlet Santa Barbara County Chardonnay 2013
notes: This wine offers slightly more richness and ripe fruit both aromatically and on the palate. Lovely white floral notes with golden delicious apple, poached pear and sweet baking spice. Aged for 16 months on fine lees in 100% French oak, 16% new, this wine brings great concentration, vibrant acidity, tension, and chalky minerality.

name: Deovlet Santa Barbara County Chardonnay 2014
notes: This wine offers slightly more richness and ripe fruit both aromatically and on the palate. Lovely white floral notes with golden delicious apple, poached pear and sweet baking spice. Aged for 16 months on fine lees in 100% French oak, 16% new, this wine brings great concentration, vibrant acidity, tension, and chalky minerality.

name: Deovlet Santa Barbara County Chardonnay 2015
notes: Bright and lifted out of the glass with tropical notes of green mango, fresh pineapple, candied ginger, and caramelized lemon peel, alongside hints of toasty oak, vanilla bean, pencil shaving and peanut skin. Our entry level chardonnay, coming from two distinct appellations (Santa Maria Valley and Sta. Rita Hills), offers purity and balance with vibrant acidity, tension, and chalky minerality.

name: Deovlet Santa Barbara County Pinot Noir 2014
notes: This broad and complex wine brings pure varietal expression from two distinct appellations, layered with the purity of fruit and mid palate concentration from Sta. Rita Hills with a vibrancy and roundness from Santa Maria Valley, all working together with dusty tannins providing structure to complement the wines seamless length and approachability.

name: Deovlet Santa Barbara County Pinot Noir 2017
notes: Capturing the region with its wonderful balance, vibrancy, and richness this Santa Barbara County offering has beautiful complexity with a mélange of red fruit, blood orange, juicy red plum, earthy undertones alongside baking spices, floral notes, wild herbs, and hints of crushed rock.  The wine offers pure varietal identity with layered complexities from each site, good concentration, and lovely freshness supported by a silky texture completing the wines seamless length.

name: Deovlet Solomon Hills Vineyard Chardonnay 2011
notes: Focused, bright, and lively, with chalky texture and minerality this wine is beautifully balanced wrapped in a medium bodied frame. Layers of lemon zest and citrus blossom, with golden delicious apple, and pear are complimented by hazelnut, baked brioche, and spice. Hints of graham cracker, vanilla, and coconut offer well integrated characteristics from French oak, roughly 20% new.

name: Deovlet Zotovich Vineyard Chardonnay 2011
notes: Stunning aromatics with remarkable purity and finesse, this wine has excellent depth and richness. Lifted by citrus fruit and layers of ripe stone fruit, along with spicy notes of ginger, white pepper, and anise all underlined by a kiss of tropical fruit shining through on the palate. Subtle French oak, roughly 25% new, offers toasted hazelnut and peanut skin. The sandy soils of this site, lying squarely in the middle of the appellation, volunteer an earthiness and briny sea shell, mineral driven finish to the wine.

name: Deovlet Zotovich Vineyard Chardonnay 2016
region: Sta. Rita Hills, Santa Barbara, Central Coast, California
notes: Bright and captivating aromatics are layered with finger lime, D’Anjou pear, sea spray and oyster shell, white flowers and ground hazelnut. The wine offers a softer, round palate presence, supported by chalky minerality and great length with lively acidity keeping the wines tension.

name: Department 66 Fragile Rose 2016
notes: In the glass, the wine shimmers with a pale hue of translucent garnet. Soft aromatics of dried rose petals prevail and invite a tasting. With bright hints of strawberry and ripe stone fruits, the wine leads to an opulent mid-palate. Finishing with purpose, it is long and riddled with layers of texture and grace.

name: Department 66 Grenache 2011
region: Maury, Roussillon, South of France, France
notes: A deep, ruby complexion envelops the glass suggesting a mighty wine. It is perfumed with a tempting fusion of red and black fruits, mountain flowers, kirsch, herbes de Provence, and a wreath of new French oak. Silky and intensely rich, the palate is lead down a path of exotic flavors including blackberry, maraschino cherry, mocha, and raspberry puree. A fine mineral component augments a persistent finish that is wrapped in sleek and satiny tannins.

name: Department 66 Grenache 2012
region: Maury, Roussillon, South of France, France
notes: A deep, ruby complexion envelops the glass suggesting a mighty wine. It is perfumed with a tempting fusion of red and black fruits, mountain flowers, kirsch, herbes de Provence, and a wreath of new French oak. Silky and intensely rich, the palate is lead down a path of exotic flavors including blackberry, maraschino cherry, mocha, and raspberry puree. A fine mineral component augments a persistent finish that is wrapped in sleek and satiny tannins.

name: Department 66 Grenache 2013
region: Maury, Roussillon, South of France, France
notes: The 2013 is of great elegance where the richness of old vine Grenache commands attention. Opaque and dense purple in appearance, the wine brims with spicy blueberry and ripe black currant fruit aromatics. Mighty upon entry, lush red fruits are met with just a hint of creamy, toasty oak. The intensity and concentration of the mid palate leads to a long finish with hints of wild fennel and garrigue.

name: Department 66 Grenache 2014
region: Maury, Roussillon, South of France, France
notes: Optimum growing conditions with a crowning harvest mark the 2014 vintage. A saturated cardinal hue belted in garnet is revealed in the glass. The nose brims with an impeccable oak profile with shaded oak tree accents. A mineral cast of alluvial soil can be detected as well, which frames a vibrant perfume of red berry fruits, cassis, cardamom, and exotic spices. The entry bursts with a vibrant blueberry and cassis concentrate that is rounded out with the richness of a creme brulee, or crema catalana. The mid palate has vibrant acidity with distinctive mineral notes of garrigue, stone, and schist. Closing with purpose, the wine boasts silky tannins and a lengthy finish of sublime richness.

name: Department 66 Others 2014
notes: Others is a literal and figurative reference utilizing fruit beyond the D66 blend. Chosen for their unique signature, these vineyards are stylistically meant to be accessed earlier, thus resulting in a powerful yet approachable wine. Situated in the foothills of the Pyrénées-Orientales, Others is made at the Department 66 winery from 100% domaine-owned vineyards. These younger, more productive vines produce an approachable wine that is blended with our old vine Grenache from the schist soil of Maury.

name: Department 66 Others 2015
region: Maury, Roussillon, South of France, France
notes: Ruby red in coloring with a distinguished brick rim, this wine offers alluring notes of marion berries, blue fruits, compote, garriuge, and a touch of dried lavender.

name: Department 66 Pharaon 2014
notes: Smokey, sweet oak escapes the glass followed by powerful aromas of black plum, blackberry pie, vanilla bean, violets and freshly cut flowers - all enveloped by a hint of dust and pencil lead. The entry is massive and lush with ripe red fruits, black raspberry, currant and pronounced minerality. Overall, the finish is concentrated yet balanced with beams of acidity and seamlessly integrated tannins that linger on the palate.

name: Department 66 Pharaon 2015
notes: Provocative aromas of sweet oak, dark chocolate liqueur, Tahitian vanilla, sage, and plum saturate the glass in a beguiling complexion of aubergine. Sapid flavors of rhubarb, savory red fruits, and boysenberries are evident and harmoniously blend with mineral notes and schistous highlights. The tannins are firm but agreeable and primed for extended aging. Finishing with a spirited acidity, the wine elegantly charms the palate indefinitely.

name: Descendientes de Jose Palacios Corullon 2009
notes: Corullon is an assemblage from old-vine parcels in and around this town. Its combination of generosity and precision makes a case not only for Corullon's special status, but also the superiority of Alvaro's and Ricardo's winemaking.

name: Descendientes de Jose Palacios Petalos 2007
notes: In the Bierzo appellation, perched in the Northwest corner of Spain, ancient Mencía vineyards emerge from the steepest of hillsides, their roots deeply set into unique, mineral-laden soils. Under the skilled hands of Palacios and his cousin, Ricardo Perez Palacios, the forgotten black grape (believed by some to be a cousin of Cabernet Franc), has achieved new heights. The 60- to 100 year-old vines yield less than one ton per acre, resulting in a most concentrated, unique expression of this variety and of the Bierzo terroir.  A classic vintage in the appellation. The wines have rich fruit, fresh personalities, and show great structure.

name: Descendientes de Jose Palacios Petalos 2008
notes: Petalos del Bierzo is assembled from old hillside and hilltop vines across from Bierzo's western edge. The wine is vinified for immediate appeal, but it retains the estate's signature finesse and restraint.

name: Descendientes de Jose Palacios Petalos 2017
notes: The wine is vinified for immediate appeal, but it retains the estate’s signature finesse and restraint.

name: Desert Wind Ruah 2004
notes: Crafted from fruit grown in the Columbia Valley of Washington, the 2004 Desert Wind Ruah is an affirmation of eastern Washington's viticultural prowess. This full bodied, Bordeaux-inspired blend is enveloped in a lush core of concentrated blackberry fruit with a hint of anise on the palate.

name: Desert Wind Ruah 2005
notes: Crafted from fruit grown in the Columbia Valley of Washington, the Desert Wind Ruah is an affirmation of eastern Washington's viticultural prowess.  This full bodied, Bordeaux-inspired blend is enveloped in a lush core of concentrated blackberry fruit with a hint of anise on the palate.

name: Desert Wind Ruah 2007
notes: A blend of 48% Merlot, 36% Cabernet Sauvignon and 16% Cabernet Franc.

name: Desparada Fragment Sauvignon Blanc 2015
notes: You made it through to the bluffs over the beach. There were no guards. There is a tiny impossible garden here overgrown with jasmine, lemon verbena, woodsorrel and a blooming pear tree. You had no idea what to expect when you climbed through the fence of Red Gate Farm, but the seersucker clouds are perfect with your pilfered Tieguanyin tea, young plums and chiffon cake.

name: Desparada Fragment Sauvignon Blanc 2016
notes: The surface of the lake is glass-flat, frozen solid and clear. It's June above the Arctic Circle and the world is in limbo. A cabin is poofing cedar smoke and the impossible orchard is in bloom with Rainer cherry blossoms and Bosch pears. You savagely peel a Satsuma and add the flesh to your sweet lime spritz. The rind falls onto wild oregano, a heliotrope and a slate skipping stone. With each skip, the surface of the lake is shattered, as the sun burns like magnesium fire.

name: Desparada Sackcloth and Ashes Red Blend 2015
notes: The siren is screaming at the searchlights. This well appointed library is no shelter, but what better place await the edge of the world than here. A humidor well stocked with Cohiba Siglos and a decanter of rare Alpine kirsch shares the buffet with a glass bowl of ripe red currants, wild blueberries and raspberries. A bomb hits the coffee roaster across the street, ripping the heavy earth and tearing the bay laurel in the yard. Let it come, let it come you think as you light a cigar.

name: Desparada Soothsayer 2016
notes: It’s dangerous to fall asleep beneath the ripe mulberry tree: endless dreams of raspberry mazes, or milk chocolate hail or sage gardens watered with nothing but Saint Germain and then there’s always the soft muzzle of the bear licking the berries from your forehead and snapping you awake.

name: Desparada Wayfinder Chardonnay 2015
region: Santa Maria Valley, Central Coast, California
notes: The sun-dense beach is brilliant at sunset. There is a glass of ice water with lemon on the windowsill and a sharp breeze teasing the ocean. On the side table: crisp pear cookies on a plate and a Newcomb vase heavy with June’s flowers: honeysuckle, plumeria, orchids and cherry blossoms. It will be over so soon. Then back inland, to fall.

name: D'Este Vino El Molinet 2007
notes: This project started as a tribute to Tempranillo by winemaker Joaquin Galvez and Aurelio. With Tempranillo forming the backbone of Spain's most famous wines, the La Viña Cooperative in Valencia planted Tempranillo widely with the goal of reproducing some of the qualities of those famous wines. This project would not be possible without the wealth of vineyards and range of altitudes the coop has planted. Contrary to popular opinion that Valencia is too warm for Tempranillo, the cooperative has planted the varietal at a range of altitudes from 300 to nearly 900 meters above sea level, at these high altitudes, the Tempranillo ripens slowly developing a tremendous aromatic potential. The lower altitude vines take advantage of cooling sea breezes and the higher altitude vines cooler night to maintain and develop those aromatic qualities. The reason Cabernet Sauvignon is blended into the wine is to allow for a stylistic continuity vintage to vintage.

name: Destino Russian River ValleyChardonnay 1999
notes: The Wine ~  The grapes were picked at peak ripeness: 24 Brix in this vintage. Pressing was done as whole clusters, utilizing a membrane press to gently dejuice the grapes without breakage of skins, seeds, or stems.   The juice was settled for 24 hours and racked to barrel for 100% barrel fermentation.  Fermentation was conducted at approximately 55° F to promote a long, slow development of the fruit.  Three distinctive yeasts, two isolates from Burgundian cellars and another from Champagne, were used to add complexity.   Upon completion of primary fermentation, the barrels were stirred weekly to promote the breakdown of the yeasts adding additional layers of complexity as well as enhancing the creamy texture of the wine. Malolactic fermentation started at the completion of primary fermentation and continued through February. The wine was aged surlies for 16 months in barrel. This extra time allowed the slowly developing fruit to emerge and further enhance the richness and structure.  Tasting Notes ~  (Barrel Sample 3/00) Dutton:  ripe apple, butter, tightly focused but less developed at this stage, needs time to open up. Poplar:  apricot, perfumey/floral high notes, intense fruit up front.

name: Deutz Amour de Deutz Blanc de Blancs Brut Millesime 2005
notes: Inspired by the graceful cherub from whom its name derives, Amour de Deutz is a rare cuvee. The wine boasts the impish charms of youth, which will gradually softens over the years to reveal the grape's quintessential qualities in a harmony for all the senses. A unique, refined and amazing cuvee.

notes: Within the family of Deutz Cuvees, the Bruit Millesime has an upright character that is both powerful and elegant. The color is bright and the bubbles are persistent. The entry is clear-cut and stylish, with the palate then showing flavors of fruit flowers, spices, and mild tobacco. It is built and beautifully balanced.

name: Deutz Blanc de Blancs 1995
notes: The wine has a pale gold color with sparkling reflections and a delicate, constant effervescence.

name: Deutz Blanc de Blancs 1996
notes: The wine has a pale gold color with sparkling reflections and a delicate, constant effervescence.

name: Deutz Blanc de Blancs 2002
notes: The color is fine and bright, showing a pale golden hue with bronze tinges. A forward nose shows deliciously ripe aromas. Hints of flowers mingle with the main aromas of fresh pastry. The first impression is clear-cut, and the wine continues, fresh and lively, in an elegant mode. The flavors are very pure and evoke white peaches, small berry fruit and grapefruit. The finishing notes are lingering with a distinctly mineral edge. This is a wine to be drunk now for those who like Chardonnay, but it also can be cellared for a while.

name: Deutz Blanc de Blancs 2004
notes: The distinctive house style of elegance and finesse which has made Champagne Deutz one of the most respected of all Champagne houses, is reflected in this fine Blanc de Blancs Champagne. Forty percent of the grape supply is from Deutz' own vineyards, which rate 98 percent on the Champagne scale. Deutz' relationships with many of the vignerons that supply the fruit go back several generations.

name: Deutz Brut 1990
notes: Deutz Brut is a lovely rich golden color, with ripe fruit flavors of pear, apple and quince. Graced with a velvety opulence, the wine caresses the palate. This subtly vinous champagne is delicious as an aperitif, or paired with white meats, foie gras, risottos and delicate fish dishes such as monkfish, skate and perch.

name: Deutz Brut 1993
